title: Administrative Assistant / Client Communication / Case Management
description:
We are hiring a remote Virtual Assistant to own day-to-day client communication and case management for a busy New York traffic law practice. This is the firm's third VA role. You will monitor the firm's
 inbox and phone line, keep every open case moving by checking its status, and take the next action without waiting to be told.



About the firm: Law Office of Matthew J. Arpino, Esq., East Setauket, NY. The practice represents drivers in New York traffic court matters, with cases coming in directly and through referral partners

.

Position type: Full-time reporting directly to the attorney.



Key responsibilities:



 monitoring

• Monitor the firm's main inbox throughout the day and keep it at or near zero unread

• Respond to client and prospective-client
s using approved templates; route legal questions to the attorney

• Log every case-related
 (court notices, client documents, partner/agent correspondence) to the correct case file

• Flag anything urgent (upcoming court date, warrant or suspension notice, unhappy client) to the attorney the same day

Phone and client communication.

• Answer and return calls and voi
s promptly; return all messages within one business day

• Give clients status updates, explain next steps in plain language, and confirm court dates

• Collect missing information and documents from clients (ticket copies, license info, signed retainers, payments)

• Screen new inquiries, gather intake details, and pass qualified leads to the attorney

• Never give legal advice; know when to escalate



Case management

• Review every open case on a set schedule and confirm its current status and next deadline

• Check court and DMV/TVB status where accessible, and update the case management system with what you find

• Take the next action on each case: request missing documents, send reminders, calendar court dates, follow up on adjournments, confirm dispositions

• Close out finished cases: confirm outcome, notify the client, and archive the file

• Keep the attorney's calendar accurate and free of conflicts

• Coordinate with the other two VAs so nothing falls through the cracks or gets done twice



Reporting

• Send the attorney a short end-of-day summary: cases moved, issues flagged, items waiting on him

• Maintain a running list of cases with upcoming court dates in the next 14 days



A typical day

1. Start of shift: clear overnight
s and voi
s; flag anything urgent.

2. Court-date check: review cases with court dates in the next 14 days; confirm clients are notified and files are complete.

3. Case status sweep: work through the day's assigned block of open cases, check status, and take the next action on each.

4. Midday: return calls, follow up on outstanding client documents and payments.

5. Ongoing: keep the inbox and phone line covered throughout the shift.

6. End of shift: update the case system and send the attorney the end-of-day summary.



Qualifications

Required

• 2+ years as an administrative assistant, virtual assistant, or customer-service rep

• Excellent written and spoken English; clear, professional, and friendly on the phone

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of
s and calls without letting items slip

• Self-starter who takes action on cases rather than waiting for instructions

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable with deadlines

• Strong judgment about what to handle and what to escalate

• Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a headset

• Available during U.S. Eastern business hours, but can be flexible on start and end times 



Preferred

• Experience at a law firm, especially traffic, criminal, or personal-injury practices, but not a must.

• Familiarity with New York traffic courts, the TVB, or DMV processes

• Experience with legal case management software (e.g., Clio)

• Comfort with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, VoIP phone systems, and e-signature tools

title: Senior Paid Media Analyst (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for a full-time Senior Paid Media Analyst to independently own the strategy, execution, and performance of Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns across assigned client accounts.



This is not a “follow the platform recommendations” role. We need an analytical, proactive problem-solver who knows how to scale e-commerce campaigns profitably, spots growth opportunities without being asked, and takes real ownership of client results.



What You’ll Do



CAMPAIGN AND STRATEGY MANAGEMENT

Build, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta campaigns from scratch

Develop paid media strategies tied to client goals: e-commerce revenue, profitability, and lead generation

Manage budgets, pacing, bidding, targeting, and spend allocation

Run keyword research, search term analysis, and audience development

Manage Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta prospecting, remarketing, and catalog campaigns

Test campaign structures, bidding, audiences, creative, and new platform features

Troubleshoot performance drops, conversion tracking discrepancies, and delivery issues

Collaborate with internal teams on creative direction, promotions, and client initiatives



E-COMMERCE GROWTH

Build strategies that grow online sales, revenue, and profitable customer acquisition

Analyze ROAS, revenue, conversion rate, AOV, and CAC

Scale winning campaigns through budget allocation, audience expansion, product segmentation, and creative testing

Evaluate product-level performance across Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta catalog campaigns

Make recommendations based on revenue and profitability, not traffic or engagement



REPORTING AND CLIENT COMMUNICATIONS

title: B2B Printing Services - Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
About the Role



The Print Company is a Toronto-based commercial printing company helping multi-location organizations across Canada with all their printing needs - from branded merchandise to strategic print planning. We're looking for a full-time cold caller / appointment setter to help us connect with decision-makers ahead of our year-end campaign.



This is a relationship-first outbound role - not a high-pressure sales position. Your job is to confidently open professional conversations with decision-makers, introduce our services, identify potential fit, and book short discovery calls with our team. - Book qualified appointments for our team's discovery calls

- Follow a structured follow-up cadence for prospects who aren't ready yet

- Report regularly on calls made, conversations had, and appointments booked

- Excellent spoken English - clear, natural conversational fluency; this is a phone-first role

- Prior experience in cold-calling or appointment-setting, ideally B2B

- Comfortable speaking with business decision-makers and able to build rapport quickly

- Organized - comfortable logging calls and keeping records accurate and up to date

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet space to make calls

- Able to work full-time hours overlapping with Eastern Time (Canada) business hours



What We Offer



- Stable, full-time remote role

- Clear instructions and structured workflows

- Long-term opportunity with a growing print company

- Professional, respectful working environment



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction, resume, and relevant files

2. A short voice recording introducing yourself (this helps us assess spoken English fluency, since this is a phone-first role)

5. What your ideal workflow and tech stack look like

6. Your expected monthly salary

7. Confirmation of availability for EST hours

title: Local SEO & Digital Marketing Generalist
description:
Primary Focus: Local SEO, Google Maps, Website SEO, Content, Reputation, and Organic Growth



Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Local SEO & Digital Marketing Generalist to manage and grow the online presence of our California, USA -based Upscale Sandwich Chain and its 6 storefront locations. Sandwicheez has been in operation since 2010 and now ready to grow across California and other Parts of USA. 



You will build and execute tailored Local SEO strategies for each individual location while maintaining a strong, unified brand presence across all locations. A key part of the role will be developing and optimizing local-focused content that connects with customers in each community, improves local search visibility, and drives more traffic and visits to our stores.



Key Responsibilities

1. Multi-Location Local SEO & Google Maps Management

 Google Business Profile (GBP): Manage, audit, and continuously optimize profiles for all 6 locations. Publish regular GBP posts for specials, menu updates, and catering promotions.

 Hyper-Local Strategy: Develop location-specific SEO strategies tailored to Oakland and San Ramon neighborhoods, ensuring distinct geographic targeting and high-intent keyword ranking (e.g., lunch, takeout, corporate/event catering).

 Location Landing Pages: Create and maintain dedicated website pages for each storefront complete with accurate NAP (Name, Address, Phone), localized content, directions, and Restaurant/Local Business structured data (schema).



2. On-Page, Website & Technical SEO

 On-Page Optimization: Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, internal links, and menu/catering pages for search relevance and conversions.

 CMS & Technical Health: Make basic content updates, monitor Google Search Console for indexing/crawling issues, and coordinate with developers for complex fixes.



3. Citation Management, Reviews & Reputation

 Local Listings: Ensure accurate, consistent NAP data across Yelp, Apple Maps, Google, and relevant food/directory platforms. Resolve duplicate or outdated citations.

 Reputation Tracking: Monitor customer reviews across platforms, assist store managers with professional responses, track review trends per location, and support strategies to gather genuine reviews.



4. SEO Content, Outreach & Market Research

 Localized Content: Plan and write SEO-friendly resources (e.g., catering guides, meeting/event lunch guides, local food articles) that drive organic traffic and conversions.

 Competitor Intelligence: Monitor local competitors, analyze their local search visibility and keyword strategy, and provide actionable recommendations.

 Local Outreach: Pursue quality, legitimate local backlinks and partnerships through community involvement, local events, and sponsorships.



5. Analytics & Performance Reporting

 Metrics Tracking: Monitor organic traffic, Google Maps performance (calls, clicks, directions), keyword rankings, and catering leads using GA4, GSC, GBP Insights, and SEO tools.

 Business-Focused Reporting: Deliver clear, non-technical monthly reports connecting SEO activities directly to store traffic and business revenue.



6. General Digital Marketing Support

 Provide cross-functional support for website updates,
 marketing, online promotions, social media coordination, and basic digital asset management as needed.





Qualifications & Requirements

Required:

 5+ years of hands-on SEO and Digital Marketing experience, specifically focused on Local SEO and Multi-Location management (5 or 6+ physical storefronts).

 The candidate must have great writing skillset 

 Proven track record optimizing Google Business Profiles, Google Maps, and local citations and directory experience.

 Strong on-page SEO skills, keyword research capability, and localized content writing experience.

 Proficient with GA4, Google Search Console, and SEO tools and platforms

 Familiarity with restaurant/local business schema markup.

 Excellent written communication and project management skills; ability to work independently.

 Direct experience in the restaurant, food service, catering, or franchise industries is a huge plus.

 Experience with backlinks or link building and internal linking is highly preferred.





DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HAVE THESE QUALIFICATIONS. APPLICANTS WITH NO ACTUAL SEO EXPERIENCE WILL NOT BE ACCOMMODATED.



Core Ownership Breakdown

 Primary (70%): Local SEO, GBP/Google Maps, Multi-Location Strategy, On-Page SEO, Citations & Reputation, Local Content, SEO Analytics.

 Secondary / Generalist (30%): CMS Updates,
/Digital Marketing Support, Local Outreach, General Marketing Support.

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly analytical, results-driven **Amazon PPC Manager** to join our growing e-commerce team.



The ideal candidate must have extensive hands-on experience managing and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns, with a proven track record of increasing sales, improving profitability, and managing advertising budgets effectively.



You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing Amazon PPC strategies across our product portfolio while maintaining target ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS.



 Key Responsibilities



**Amazon PPC Campaign Management**



- Create, manage, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

- Develop and execute PPC strategies to increase sales, improve organic rankings, and maximize profitability.

- Manage advertising budgets across multiple products and campaigns.

- Plan and execute advertising strategies for new product launches and seasonal promotions.

- Monitor campaign performance and make daily optimizations.



**Keyword Research & Bid Optimization**



- Conduct in-depth keyword research, competitor analysis, and search term harvesting.

- Optimize keyword bids, placements, and targeting strategies.

- Identify and eliminate wasted advertising spend through negative keyword optimization.

- Monitor keyword rankings and adjust PPC strategies accordingly.

- Utilize manual and automated bidding strategies to improve campaign performance.



**Performance Analysis & Reporting**



- Track and analyze key performance metrics, including ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, ad spend, and total sales.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.

- Prepare weekly and monthly PPC performance reports.

- Provide data-driven recommendations to improve advertising efficiency and profitability.

- Analyze advertising performance in relation to organic sales and overall business growth.



**PPC Tools & Automation**



- Utilize Amazon Seller Central and Advertising Console for campaign management.

- Work with tools such as Helium 10, DataDive, Jungle Scout, and other Amazon analytics platforms.

- Manage and optimize campaigns using PPC automation software such as Perpetua, Pacvue, BidX, or similar platforms.

- Leverage AI tools for keyword research, campaign analysis, advertising optimization, and reporting.

- Stay updated on Amazon Advertising developments and best practices.



**Collaboration & Growth**



- Coordinate with listing optimization, inventory, and marketing teams to align PPC strategies with business objectives.

- Adjust advertising strategies based on stock availability, product performance, and profitability.

- Conduct competitor research to identify growth opportunities.

- Recommend strategies to improve market share and overall brand performance.



Qualifications & Requirements



- **Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience** managing Amazon PPC campaigns.

- Proven track record of successfully managing Amazon advertising accounts and delivering measurable results.

- Strong expertise in Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display advertising.

- Experience managing significant monthly advertising budgets.

- Excellent understanding of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and other Amazon advertising metrics.

- Advanced knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Advertising Console.

- Experience using Helium 10, DataDive, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon analytics tools.

- Hands-on experience with PPC automation and bid-management software.

- Familiarity with Amazon DSP is a strong advantage.

- Experience using AI-powered tools for PPC optimization and data analysis.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple campaigns, and meet performance targets in a remote environment.

title: Senior Meta Ads + Social Strategist - CAPI, Full Setup (40-50k)
description:
ABOUT US



We are an Australian digital marketing agency. We run
 and Instagram advertising for trade and home service businesses: solar and battery, air conditioning, electrical, pools, roofing and builders. Every campaign is tracked from the ad click to the booked job, so we know what produced revenue and what only produced clicks.



We are small, fast and AI first. You will work directly with the founder.



We have not named the company in this ad on purpose. If your application gets through the first screen, we tell you exactly who we are by
, before any interview.



THE ROLE



We are looking for one senior person who owns the complete Meta system for our clients. Not just the ads. Everything.



That means four things, and we need all of them:



1. Strategy. You d
 what we test. You read an account, work out why it is underperforming, and choose the offer, the angle and the hook. You know when the problem is the offer and not the targeting, and you can explain why.



2. The technical setup. When a new client signs, you onboard them into Meta completely: Business Manager, ad account, page, pixel, Conversions API, domain verification, events, and leads flowing into our CRM. When you are done, every piece of data Meta needs is going in, correctly, and you can prove it.



3. Running it. You build the campaigns, launch them, watch them, and d
 what to kill, what to scale and what to test next.



4. Social media strategy. Alongside the paid ads, you help run the organic social side for our clients: the concepts, the content strategy and the creative direction. The posting itself is automated. What we need from you is the thinking.



You will not be doing this alone. You work alongside the founder, who has run these accounts himself. We have our own video and design team who make the creative, and AI workflows that produce ad variations fast. You brief them. You do not need to open Photoshop or Premiere.



We are AI first. You must be genuinely willing to learn new workflows and new tools. We provide and pay for a Claude account and you will use it every day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Strategy and testing

- Take over an existing account and write a diagnosis before touching anything: is it the offer, the angle, the creative, the audience, the landing page, the tracking, or the follow-up

- Choose the offer. A guarantee, a price frame, a bundle, a callback promise. You know offer changes move cost per lead more than targeting does

- Choose angles and hooks, and test one variable at a time so the result means something

- Hold to real test rules. You do not kill an ad at 400 impressions and you do not let a loser bleed for three weeks

- Build a campaign structure per industry that we can roll out across several clients in the same industry

- Use the Ad Library to map what is already working in a market



Full Meta onboarding for new clients

- Get partner access into the client's Business Manager, or set one up properly if they do not have one

- Set up or connect the ad account,
 page, Instagram account and payment method

- Install the Meta pixel and the Conversions API, and verify events in Events Manager, including deduplication between browser and server events

- Verify the client's domain in Business Manager

- Configure the events that matter: leads, booked appointments, and where possible the closed job

- Talk a non-technical business owner through their own settings on a live video call, calmly and in clear English



Leads into the CRM, and data back into Meta

- Connect Meta lead forms to our CRM (GoHighLevel) so every lead arrives instantly, with the right fields, and triggers the follow-up

- Send CRM stages back to Meta (for example: qualified, booked, sold) so Meta optimises for real jobs, not just form fills

- Website tracking: Meta pixel and CAPI on landing pages, Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4, UTM parameters done consistently

- Test every form and every integration yourself, live, and keep the proof



Social media strategy

- Plan the organic content strategy for each client: themes, formats, hooks and a content calendar that supports the paid ads

- Come up with concepts for Reels, carousels and short-form video, and brief the creative team to make them

- Research what is working on social in each industry and turn it into ideas we can actually shoot

- Use our automated scheduling and AI systems, and read the results to d
 what to make more of



The developer side of Meta

- Meta for Developers: create and manage apps, system users and access tokens, and understand permissions

- Comfortable with webhooks and with reading API documentation. You do not need to be a programmer, but you are not scared of it either



Reporting

- We measure cost per booked job, not cost per lead

- If a campaign failed, say it failed and say why. We want bad news early, not a padded report

- You will be on calls with Australian business owners explaining your decisions



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Senior. Several years running
 and Instagram lead generation with real money behind it. Local service businesses strongly preferred. Ecommerce only is a weaker fit

- A track record you can show: real accounts, real numbers, real results

- Real hands-on experience with the Conversions API, Events Manager and Business Manager setup, not just running ads in an account someone else set up

- Strong opinions about offers and angles, and evidence you have been right before

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Careful. You check before you change and you test after. A broken pixel or a lead that never reaches the CRM costs our clients real money



- A strong grasp of organic social media: what makes content work on Instagram and
, and how organic and paid support each other

- Creative at a high level. You can do the research, find the angle and turn it into a concept



Nice to have: GoHighLevel, Google Ads, Looker Studio, Australian market experience, trade or construction clients.



WHY JOIN US



- You work directly with a founder who has around 20 years of marketing experience, works with established multi-million dollar businesses, and works at a high level in AI.

- A team of 10+ professionals across every field we work in: video, design, CRM builds, development and AI. You are not doing everything alone, and the people around you know exactly what they are doing.

- The best AI systems we can find, built into how we work every day. You will learn tools most agencies have not touched yet.

- Good support and fast turnaround. When you need a creative asset or a fix, you are not waiting weeks.

- A great environment to learn and to grow into a key player in the business, not a ticket queue.



THE MONEY, PLAINLY



PHP 40,000 to 50,000 per month, based on proven experience. Where you land in that range depends on what you can show us, not on what you claim.



On day one you get a written standard for this seat. At 60 days we review your delivery against it.



THE ARRANGEMENT, IN PLAIN TERMS



- Independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice us and we pay the invoice.

- You are responsible for your own tax and contributions. We do not pay SSS, PhilHealth or Pag-IBIG.

- No paid annual leave, no paid sick leave, no 13th month pay. We are telling you now so there are no surprises later.

- Paid twice a month, in PHP, by Wise.

- 7:00am to 3:30pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday, with some flexibility for live client calls in Australian business hours.

- Full time and exclusive. No other retained clients and no other agencies while you are engaged with us.

- 3 month probation. Two weeks written notice, either way.

- A PAID test task before any offer: a real account diagnosis, a short campaign and testing plan, and a written onboarding and tracking setup plan. We pay for your time whether or not we make an offer.

- Your own computer, 25 Mbps or better internet, a backup connection, and a plan for power outages.

- You will be inside client ad accounts and CRMs. You sign a contractor agreement and an NDA before you get access to anything.



HOW THE INTERVIEW WORKS



- If you pass the first screen, we
 you, tell you who we are, and offer one fixed interview time. Confirm it in writing or we do not hold it.

- If something comes up, tell us before the slot and we will rebook you once. If you do not turn up and did not tell us, your application is closed.

- The interview is a 30 minute screen share. We put a real ad account and a real Events Manager on the screen and ask what you would change and why.

- Do not claim anything you cannot show live. Honest experience, even if small in places, is fine. A claim that disappears on screen is not.



HOW TO APPLY



Line one of your application must read: OFFER followed by the total ad spend you have personally managed, and the currency.



Example: OFFER USD 240,000



Applications that do not start this way are not read. That is the only trick in this ad and we have just told you what it is.



Then seven things.



1. YOUR CV. Attached or linked. A LinkedIn profile on its own is not a CV.



2. THE LIST. Copy it and put ONE word next to every line. DONE = done it on a real account (say the industry). READ = understand it, never done it. NEVER = never done it or do not know what it means. Most people will have some NEVERs. Honest NEVERs beat a list of all DONEs, which we trust less, not more.



   1. Taken over an underperforming account and written a diagnosis before changing anything

   2. Run a test where only the OFFER changed, and measured the effect on cost per lead

   3. Run a test where only the hook changed

   4. Written a creative brief an editor executed without coming back with questions

   5. Built a campaign structure and reused it across several clients in the same industry

   6. Onboarded a new client into Meta from scratch: Business Manager, ad account, page, pixel

   7. Requested and been granted partner access to a client's Business Manager

   8. Set up the Conversions API (any method: partner integration, Gateway, server-side GTM, direct)

   9. Fixed deduplication between pixel and Conversions API events

   10. Verified a domain in Business Manager

   11. Connected Meta lead forms to a CRM so leads arrive instantly

   12. Sent CRM stages back to Meta (qualified, booked, sold) for optimisation

   13. Created a Meta developer app and a system user with an access token

   14. Installed Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 with events verified

   15. Worked to cost per booked job from CRM data, not just cost per lead

   16. Managed five or more ad accounts at the same time

   17. Run ads for a trade, home service or construction business

   18. Talked a client through their own Meta settings on a live call

   19. Planned and run an organic social media content strategy for a business



3. AN ACCOUNT YOU TURNED AROUND. One real account. In your own words: what was wrong, what you changed FIRST and why that first, what happened to the numbers, and what you would do differently now. A screenshot helps. The reasoning is what we are reading.



4. A TRACKING SETUP YOU BUILT. One real client. Walk us through how the pixel, the Conversions API, the lead form and the CRM were connected, what broke, and how you proved it was working.



5. A CREATIVE BRIEF YOU WROTE. One real brief you gave to a designer or editor, pasted exactly as they received it, even if rough. If you cannot share one, write a new one for this: an Australian solar installer, family owned, premium end of the market, paying too much per lead on a generic free solar quote ad.



6. HOW YOU USE AI. One real example of how you use AI tools in your ads work today.



7. YOUR NUMBER AND YOUR
.

- The monthly PHP figure you are working for now, and the figure you need to commit to us full time and exclusively.

- An
 address we can reach you on.



Write it yourself. Use AI to fix your spelling if you like. If AI writes your answers, it will show in the first three minutes of the interview, because we put a live account on the screen and ask what you would change.

s and prioritise important messages.

Determine whether each business has an official website.

Identify clear, specific reasons why each company represents a potential sales opportunity.



Classify businesses as HIGH PRIORITY, REVIEW, or REJECT.

This will be a paid trial.

title: Senior Operations Manager, Contact Center & Customer Experience - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn’t exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation’s largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. We’re doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem on the practice’s behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We’re changing that, backed by 15 years of operational credibility — and we’re looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We’re building the AI infrastructure behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you’re in the right place.



Position Overview:

As Senior Operations Manager, you own the day-to-day running of our contact center: the Client Advocate team’s performance, the customer experience it delivers, and the ticketing and support queues behind it. You report to the Head of Contact Center Operations & Country Manager, who sets the operating model and strategic direction. You own execution across the entire floor, not just one team or shift.



You lead through your Team Leads, who are your direct reports and who manage the Senior Client Advocates and the QA and Training functions day to day. You’re accountable for the service levels the floor produces together: SLA, quality, ticketing throughput, and the client experience at every touchpoint. This is a senior, hands-on leadership seat for someone who catches performance dips before they become trends, finds and fixes friction in the client journey, and gives leadership clean, accurate data. You inherit a floor already in motion, and you own making it perform.



Key Responsibilities:



Client Advocate Team Leadership



Lead the entire Client Advocate floor through your Team Leads, who manage Senior Client Advocates and QA/Training day to day

Coach and develop Team Leads directly: weekly 1:1s, call calibrations, structured performance reviews, and real-time feedback

Build a bench: identify high-performing Team Leads and emerging leaders, and create clear promotion pathways into senior roles

Set performance expectations and accountability standards across the floor, consistent with the operating model set by the Head of Contact Center Operations



Customer Experience & Journey Mapping



Serve as the senior escalation point for complex service issues and own the client experience at the operational level

Map and continuously improve the client journey across all touchpoints: identify friction, close gaps, and drive measurable CSAT improvement

Turn CX findings into concrete floor-level changes: updated scripts, routing adjustments, coaching priorities, or process fixes



Contact Center Operations & Ticketing



Own day-to-day performance across inbound/outbound voice,
, chat, and ticketing, with direct accountability for SLA attainment, handle time, first-contact resolution, and quality scores

Own the ticketing and support queue end to end: triage, assignment, escalation paths, and resolution timelines

Manage real-time staffing and workload distribution across channels as volume shifts

Execute established SOPs and playbooks; flag gaps or drift to the Head of Contact Center Operations

Partner with Training to shorten onboarding-to-production ramp without sacrificing quality



Quality Assurance & Reporting



Oversee the QA process for the full team: audits against the established rubric, with structured coaching feedback delivered to Team Leads

Own the floor-level KPI dashboard: SLA, AHT, FCR, CSAT, ticket resolution time, attendance. Accurate and current, no surprises for leadership

Deliver weekly and monthly performance reporting to the Head of Contact Center Operations

Communicate capacity risks, CX trends, and performance dips proactively, solution-first



Systems & Compliance



Drive full-team adoption of the CRM/ticketing platform through training, live coaching, and compliance monitoring

Ensure day-to-day adherence to HIPAA and related data privacy/security requirements across all client interactions.



Qualifications



Required:



8+ years in contact center or BPO operations, with proven ownership of end-to-end service delivery for a full site, account, or team, not just a single queue or shift

Supervisory experience with direct accountability for Team Leads or supervisors (managing people who manage frontline agents)

Demonstrated ownership of customer experience and journey mapping: identified friction across touchpoints and drove measurable CSAT improvement

Proven experience running high-volume, multi-channel operations (voice,
, chat, ticketing) with SLA and quality accountability across the whole floor

Comfortable owning a ticketing/CRM platform and its queues end to end

Strong coaching orientation at scale: has run calibrations and structured feedback across multiple teams or Team Leads

Excellent written and verbal English for daily interaction with U.S.-based leadership



Nice-to-Have:



Healthcare BPO, compliance services, or U.S.-facing contact center background

Salesforce Service Cloud exposure

Workforce management platforms (NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar)

HIPAA familiarity

Six Sigma, COPC, or equivalent quality certification

Experience mentoring Team Leads into people-management roles and building internal promotion pathways



Compensation & Benefits:



Salary Range: $1,500-$2,000/month (depending on level of experience)

Permanent work-from-home

40 hours per week, Monday-Friday, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift)

Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

Work Anniversary Bonus

No work with pay on US Holidays

Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment



Basic Technical Requirements:



Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards

A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

Noise-canceling headset/headphones

A quiet and dedicated workspace at home



Application Process:



To submit your application,
 the following to 

Your most updated resume

Use the following subject line: [Your Full Name] - Senior Operations Manager - Remote



Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Crypto BD Team Lead: $1,500-2,500/mo Base Pace + Uncapped Deal Bonuses (Remote)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

title: Senior Meta Ads Manager / Media Buyer (Webinars & Events, Hyros)
description:
ABOUT US

The Nonprofit Guy helps nonprofit founders and executives start, fund, and grow their organizations through coaching, done-for-you services, and an online academy. Paid ads drive our weekly webinars and major monthly events: challenges, summits, and bootcamps with thousands of registrants.



Our Meta ad account is seasoned, we are scaling toward $50,000 per month. We need an experienced ads manager who can consistently manage high spend, protect performance, and lead our creative strategy, from ad scripts to targeting.



SCHEDULE

Full time, 40 hours per week. Must overlap at least 4 hours with US Eastern Time.



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

- Daily: send a performance report and discuss ad performance with the CEO

- Daily: review every active ad and make adjustments as needed

- Weekly: strategy meeting to review results, creative, and the plan for the week ahead



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Campaign Management

- Manage and optimize our Meta ad account every day

- Run campaigns for weekly webinars and monthly events (challenges, summits, and bootcamps)

- Manage CBO and ABO structures, budgets, bidding, and scaling

- Consistently manage high daily spend while protecting cost per lead and cost per purchase

- Launch event campaigns on schedule, coordinated with our funnel and automation launches



Daily Optimization

- Review all active ads daily: what to scale, what to adjust, and what to turn off

- Track and act on CPL, cost per registrant, cost per purchase, CTR, CPM, hook rate, and ROAS

- Spot rising costs early and fix them before they hurt results



Ad Scripting and Creative Strategy

- Write high-performing video ad scripts: hooks, story, offer, and call to action

- Write ad copy, headlines, and hook variations for testing

- Analyze which creatives and angles are winning and identify what we need more of

- Brief our in-house designer and our CEO on new creatives and video ads every week

- Research competitors and trends using the Meta Ads Library



Targeting

- Define and refine our ideal buyer: aspiring nonprofit founders and nonprofit executives

- Build and test audiences: broad, interest, lookalike, and retargeting

- Use buyer data from Hyros and our CRM to find and target more people like our best customers



Tracking and Attribution

- Own our Hyros setup: tracking, attribution, and reporting

- Work with our GHL automation specialist to keep Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and UTM tracking accurate

- Make decisions based on Hyros-attributed revenue, not just Meta-reported results



DAILY REPORT INCLUDES

- Spend, CPL, cost per registrant, cost per purchase, and ROAS (Meta and Hyros)

- Top and bottom performing ads

- Changes made today and why

- What you recommend for tomorrow



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- CPL and cost per purchase stable or improving as spend scales

- Hyros-attributed ROAS at or above target

- New ad scripts and creatives tested every week

- Event campaigns live on schedule, every time

- Clear, honest daily reports



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years managing Meta ads

- Proven experience managing $30,000+ per month in a single account

- Experience running ads for webinars, virtual events, courses, or coaching businesses

- Strong ad scripting and copywriting skills with examples of winning ads

- Hands-on Hyros experience (required)

- Strong understanding of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and attribution

- Proven experience scaling budgets without losing performance

- Excellent written English and clear reporting

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace



BONUS

- Experience with GoHighLevel

- Experience with high-ticket offers or application funnels

- Video editing or UGC creative direction experience

- YouTube or Google Ads experience



PAY

$1,000 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus a monthly performance bonus when Hyros-attributed ROAS and cost per purchase stay on target at our planned budget.



HIRING PROCESS

Application review, then a paid account audit and ad script test, then a live strategy interview, then a paid trial period.



HOW TO APPLY

Send:

1. A short Loom (under 5 minutes) walking through a high-spend Meta ad account you managed: the structure, what was working, and what you changed to improve results. Blur private client details.

2. Screenshots of results from accounts you managed: spend, CPL, cost per purchase, and ROAS. Blur client names.

3. One video ad script you wrote that performed well, with its results

4. Answers to the screening questions below

5. Start your subject line with "Nonprofit Guy Ads Manager"



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. What's the highest monthly spend you've managed in one account, and what were the results?

2. We want to scale from about $11,000 to $50,000 per month over 6 months. How would you do it without losing ROAS?

3. Meta shows a 4x ROAS, but Hyros shows 2.5x. Which do you trust, and what do you do next?

4. Our webinar CPL jumped 40% this week. Walk us through what you check, in order.

5. How do you d
 when to kill an ad, keep testing it, or scale it?

6. Write a 3-line hook for a video ad promoting a free webinar on how to start and fund a nonprofit.

7. How do you d
 what type of creative we need more of?

title: Amazon Sourcing Virtual Assistant (Online/Retail Arbitrage)
description:
ob details

Pay: $6.00 per hour

Work location: Remote – Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor

A growing US-based Amazon seller is looking for an experienced sourcing VA who can find profitable, buyable leads through original research and explain why each one is worth buying. You'll source for two partner sellers who share all leads from day one, working with the owners and an existing sourcing teammate in a long-term role with real room to grow in responsibility and pay.

About the role

Your main focus at the start is Amazon FBA sourcing through online and retail arbitrage. You'll work side by side with our sourcing teammate, sharing leads and lessons. This is a partnership, not a competition: we succeed as a team.

What you'll do

Find profitable online and retail arbitrage leads through your own research

Vet every lead with Keepa and SellerAmp (SAS): sales rank, price history, Buy Box behavior, seller count, and Amazon on the listing

Check IP complaint history, brand gating, and hazmat/DG status before recommending a buy

Source qualified hazmat and dangerous goods (DG) leads too, especially lithium-battery products: our sellers are approved by Amazon to sell hazmat/DG through FBA

Calculate true profit and ROI, including shipping, sales tax, and Amazon fees

Log leads clearly in our shared Google Sheets

You'll be expected to deliver a steady daily volume of fully vetted leads (daily target shared during onboarding).

What we require

At least 2 years of proven, hands-on Amazon FBA sourcing experience (online and/or retail arbitrage), with specific examples of past results

Working experience with Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp (SAS), and Google Sheets

A genuine team player who shares information openly and is glad to see a teammate succeed

Sell-safe sourcing only: authentic, correctly branded products. No generic, off-brand, misbranded, or mislabeled listings, or products that don't match the brand or detail page.

Strong written and spoken English; you ask questions early and give honest updates

Proven initiative: you spot problems and opportunities and act on them

A stable, high-speed internet connection (at least 50 Mbps download) plus a reliable backup (for example, mobile data)

A reliable computer, a two-monitor setup (your main laptop plus one additional monitor), and a quiet place to work

Lead integrity (non-negotiable)

Our leads are confidential business assets, and protecting them is part of the job. By applying, you agree to these rules:

Original sourcing only: every lead you submit must come from your own research.

Never use a lead list of any kind, whether purchased, free, shared, or recycled.

Never purchase or subscribe to a lead list or lead service for this work.

Never share our leads with anyone outside our team, including other sellers, groups, communities, or clients, during or after your engagement.

We closely track our top overlapping competitors with a Keepa competitor tracker. Leads that match lead lists or competitor activity will be investigated. Any violation results in immediate termination and forfeiture of unpaid bonuses.  A signed non-disclosure agreement (NDA) is required upon hiring.

Nice to have

Experience with ArbiSource

Experience with Multiseller Pro

Amazon customer service, FBA shipment, or prep center experience

What we offer

$6.00 USD per hour to start plus potential for performance bonuses.

A pay review after 90 days, with a raise based on performance

A 4-week paid trial to confirm mutual fit

Loyal, fair, supportive owners who treat contractors as valued, long-term team members and respect your family and life outside work

Paid weekly via PayPal

Schedule

Full-time from day one: 40 hours per week (8 hours a day, Monday to Friday).

Monday to Friday, flexible hours (split shifts welcome), with a daily US-morning overlap window, agreed together, for calls on Zoom

We don't watch the clock; we ask for a brief daily update or work log and an up-to-date shared sheet

Paid time off for major Philippine public holidays

How to apply

Submit your resume.

Answer every question in the Screening Questions section below, starting your message with the word KEEPA.

Share specific past results: products you sourced, with buy cost, sale price, ROI, and units sold (screenshots welcome; hide all confidential client details).

Applications without specific examples will not be considered.

What to expect

Our interview includes a practical work test: find 2 buyable leads through your own research, that meet our standards, then walk the owners through your process and defend each buy on a call. The work test is paid: a flat $10 for a complete submission. Candidates who pass begin the 4-week paid trial.

Screening Questions

To apply, start your message with the word KEEPA in the subject or first line, then answer each question below. Applications without KEEPA or without answers will not be reviewed.

Requirements (applications that don't meet these will not move forward):

1. How many years of hands-on Amazon FBA sourcing experience (online and/or retail arbitrage) do you have? At least 2 years is required.

2. What are your current internet download and upload speeds (please share a speedtest.net screenshot or result link), and what backup connection do you have if your main internet goes down? At least 50 Mbps download and a reliable backup connection are required. Also confirm (Yes / No): do you have a reliable computer, a two-monitor setup (your main laptop plus one additional monitor), and a quiet place to work?

3. Can you commit to full-time work from day one, 40 hours per week (8 hours a day, Monday to Friday), with a daily overlap window in the US morning (Central Time), when you're easy to reach and available for Zoom calls? (Yes / No)

Experience and fit:

4. Which of these tools have you used regularly in the last 12 months? (Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp (SAS), Google Sheets, ArbiSource, Multiseller Pro)

5. Describe your best sourcing win. Include the product category, buy cost, sale price, ROI, estimated monthly sales, units purchased, and how it sold through.

6. Walk us through how you use Keepa and SellerAmp to d
 whether a lead is buyable. Which numbers do you check, and what makes you reject a lead?

7. How do you handle gated brands and categories, IP complaint risk, and hazmat/dangerous goods (including lithium-battery items) when sourcing? How do you make sure you avoid generic, off-brand, or misbranded listings?

8. How do you find your own leads? Describe your sourcing process step by step (for example: storefront research, reverse sourcing, brand or category research, retail store scanning). Do you use purchased or shared lead lists? (We require original sourcing only.) Lead integrity agreement (Yes / No, Yes required): do you agree never to use, purchase, or subscribe to any lead list or lead service, and never to share our leads with anyone outside our team, during or after the engagement?

9. Tell us about a time you showed initiative without being asked. What did you do, and what was the result?

10. You'll work alongside an existing sourcing teammate. Describe a time you shared leads, sources, or knowledge with a colleague. How do you feel about sharing your best finds with a teammate?

We will never ask you to pay us anything to apply or to be hired. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

title: AI-Assisted Food & Travel Writer: Local Restaurants & Hidden Spots in US Cities (Revenue Share)
description:
Job Description



Do you love finding the best burger in town, the pizza place locals swear by, or the diner that has been serving pie since the 1950s? Then you will feel at home with us.




 publishes short, friendly articles about food, travel and local gems in US cities and states. Most of our readers find us on NewsBreak, a local news feed that shows each article to people who live in the city it covers. That means we write for real local readers: people who want to know where to eat this weekend and why their neighbors love a place.



We are growing, and we are hiring 3 new authors every week for the next 4 weeks.



What You Will Do



- Pick a city and a local restaurant, attraction or topic from our current list

- Create a first draft with AI tools (like Grok or Perplexity) using our ready-made template

- Edit the draft so it reads naturally, with short and clear sentences

- Fact-check every detail: the business is open, and the address, hours, prices and menu items are correct

- Write strong headlines in the styles that work best for us (see below)

- Add properly licensed images and publish on WordPress under your own byline



Article Formats That Work



- List articles: "Best Diners in [State]", "8 Ohio Burger Joints Under $5"

- "Why locals love…" angles: "Why Lexington Locals Keep Coming Back to This Tiny Biscuit Shop"

- Origin and longevity stories: "Open Since 1958, This Fort Wayne Diner Still Makes Pie Every Morning"

- Award and readers' poll headlines (only when the award is real and you can show the source): "Voted Best Burger in Cincinnati, This Corner Grill Is Worth the Wait"



How You Get Paid



- New authors earn 70% of the ad revenue their articles earn.

- Revenue share only. There is no flat rate per article or per hour. The more good articles you publish, the more you can earn.

- Paid monthly via PayPal or Wise.

- Your own WordPress byline from day one. Every article is tracked to you, so your earnings are always yours.

- Room to grow: our existing authors are now on a higher share. Strong, steady, long-term authors can move up to a higher share over time.



What We Are Looking For



- Excellent written English: clear, simple and natural

- Experience with AI writing tools (Grok, Perplexity, ChatGPT or similar)

- Comfortable with WordPress (writing, formatting, adding images, tags and categories)

- Careful with facts. You double-check details and never invent quotes or awards

- Genuine interest in food, travel and US local culture

- Self-motivated and steady. You can keep up 3–5 articles per day, or 25 per week minimum, on your own schedule

- Basic Canva or image editing skills are a plus



Why You Will Like Working With Us



- Flexible schedule. Work when it suits you, but the general expectation 25 articles per week.

- Quick, simple workflow. A ready-made template and prompts make each article fast once you get the hang of it

- A step-by-step onboarding guide covering setup, our template, headline styles, fact-check rules and image rules

- A first-10-articles review. An editor checks your first 10 articles and gives you feedback before they go live

- Your name on your work. Your own byline from day one



How to Apply



To show you read the full post, start your application subject line with the words "Local Gems" (for example: "Local Gems – Maria Santos, Food & Travel Writer"). Applications without this will not be reviewed.



In your application, please include:



1. Why you are excited about writing food, travel and local content

2. Links to WordPress articles you have written or published

3. Your experience with AI tools (which tools, and how you use them for writing)

4. How many articles per week you can commit to



We review applications every week. We look forward to reading about your favorite local spots!
salary: 70% revenue share of ad income, monthly

title: Experienced Developer or Team Needed — Build a Complete CAPTCHA Solving Service & API
description:
’m looking for an experienced developer or small development team to build and launch a fully working CAPTCHA solving platform.



The goal is to create a service where customers can register, purchase credits, generate API keys, submit CAPTCHA tasks through an API, and track their usage through a professional dashboard. The project includes the solving backend, customer website, billing system, admin panel, deployment, and documentation.



Target timeline: Approximately one month from the agreed start date.

Budget: Und
. Please provide a realistic proposal based on your approach, experience, and deliverables.

Opportunity: Initial development with potential for ongoing paid maintenance and expansion.



Reference platforms:



CapSolver



KagedCap



DispurCaptcha



These references show the general product category and business model. We will develop our own branding and interface.



I want someone who understands both the technology behind a reliable solving service and the work required to operate it as a commercial product.



The agreed launch scope should cover:



Working CAPTCHA solving backend. Explain which CAPTCHA types you can reliably support within the first month, which you already have experience with, and which would require additional research. Relevant experience includes reCAPTCHA v2/v3, Enterprise variants, and image or text challenges. Clearly state whether your approach uses proprietary solving technology, licensed third-party services, or a hybrid. All dependencies and recurring costs must be disclosed.



Customer-facing API. Customers need secure API keys, task submission, task status and result retrieval, balance checks, and understandable error responses. The system should handle concurrent requests, timeouts, retries, and customer usage limits reliably. Include clear documentation and working integration examples in Python and JavaScript.



Professional customer dashboard. Customers should be able to create an account, sign in, manage API keys, add funds, view their balance, review usage and transaction history, and access documentation. Show useful statistics such as requests submitted, successful and failed tasks, spending, and response times. The interface should be clean, responsive, and easy to understand.



Accurate billing and credit management. Build a prepaid balance system with configurable pricing by service or CAPTCHA type. We need a clearly defined policy for billable success, failed requests, and refunds. Duplicate requests or repeated payment notifications must not create duplicate charges or credits. Include low-balance alerts and an understandable transaction ledger.



Owner/admin dashboard. I need to manage users, pricing, credits, API access, and available services. The dashboard should show revenue, usage, failures, processing times, and operating costs where measurable. It should also support customer troubleshooting and a history of important administrative changes.



Reliable hosting and operations. Recommend and configure suitable hosting, databases, background processing, monitoring, alerts, backups, and recovery procedures. The system must protect customer information, API keys, and payment-related data. Explain how capacity can grow as customer demand increases.



Testing, documentation, and handover. Deliver the complete custom source code, deployment configuration, setup instructions, API documentation, and operating guide. Development should take place in a repository I can access, with production services under accounts controlled by the business. Identify any third-party code, licenses, or services separately.



Performance needs to be demonstrated through testing. Before development begins, we should agree on measurable targets for supported CAPTCHA types, response times, validated success rates, concurrent requests, and operating costs.



A successful API response alone should not be the entire success measurement. Results should be validated in agreed, authorized test workflows, with failures and limitations reported clearly.



The one-month target is important. Please propose a realistic four-week delivery plan. A suggested structure is:



Week 1: Finalize scope and architecture, demonstrate the core solving approach, and establish initial performance and cost benchmarks.



Week 2: Complete the core API, task processing, authentication, API keys, and credit accounting.



Week 3: Complete the customer dashboard, payment integration, admin tools, and full customer workflow.



Week 4: Run integration and load testing, resolve issues, finalize documentation, and deploy the agreed launch version.



The launch should support the complete customer journey: register → add funds → generate an API key → submit a task → receive a usable result → see accurate billing and usage.



Please separate what you can commit to delivering within 30 days from features that would require a later phase. If your approach depends on unproven research, explain that upfront.



I’m particularly interested in applicants with:



Previous experience building or maintaining CAPTCHA solving systems.



Strong backend, API, and asynchronous processing experience.



Experience with SaaS dashboards, payments, and usage-based billing.



Knowledge of performance testing, monitoring, and infrastructure costs.



Relevant machine learning or computer vision experience if your proposed approach requires it.



Clear communication and availability for regular progress updates and weekly demonstrations.



When applying, please include:



Relevant projects, demos, repositories, or examples of previous work, including your specific contribution.



Your proposed architecture and solving approach.



The CAPTCHA types you can support at launch and evidence of relevant experience.



Whether you already have reusable components and the licensing or ownership terms.



Your four-week plan, availability, and any additional team members required.



A development quote broken down by milestone.



Estimated hosting, processing, third-party, and maintenance costs, including the expected cost per 1,000 successful solves under stated assumptions.



Your approach to ongoing updates when supported challenge types change.



The post-launch support period included in your quote.



The budget is open for discussion once the scope and technical approach are clear. I’m looking for a realistic proposal with transparent costs, measurable deliverables, and a strong path to a reliable, profitable service.



Please begin your application with “CAPTCHA PLATFORM” and briefly explain the most relevant system you have personally built.

title: Head of Client Management - (B2B, Remote PH)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We’re hiring a Head of Client Management to lead our core client portfolio and the account management team that serves it. You’ll manage Senior Account Managers and Account Managers, set the service standards every client in the portfolio receives, and serve as the single point of accountability for client experience, retention, and growth. This is a people-leadership role rather than an individual book of business: you’ll coach and develop the team, build the processes that let it serve a high volume of accounts consistently, and stay hands-on for escalations, at-risk accounts, and key renewals. Success is measured by the health of the portfolio and the team behind it: client satisfaction, retention, team performance, and sustainable revenue growth.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Team Leadership & People Management

·	Lead, coach, and develop a team of Senior Account Managers and Account Managers responsible for the core client portfolio.

·	Assign and balance account portfolios across the team based on account volume, complexity, and individual capacity.

·	Set clear performance expectations and run regular one-on-ones, account reviews, and monthly scorecard reviews with each team member.

·	Identify skill gaps and deliver coaching, training, and development plans; manage underperformance through documented coaching and Performance Improvement Plans when required.

·	Partner with leadership and Talent Acquisition on team capacity planning, hiring, and onboarding of new Account Managers.

·	Build a team culture of accountability, client ownership, and continuous improvement.

 

2. Client Management & Experience

·	Own the end-to-end client experience for the core client portfolio from onboarding through renewal.

·	Establish and enforce consistent service standards, client touchpoint cadences, and communication playbooks across the team.

·	Serve as the escalation point for complex client issues, at-risk accounts, and sensitive client relationships.

·	Step in directly on key client relationships, renewals, and recovery conversations where senior involvement is needed.

·	Drive client satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy across the segment through proactive, consistent engagement.

 

3. Portfolio Growth & Value Creation

·	Set segment-level retention and growth targets and translate them into individual targets for each team member.

·	Guide the team in identifying expansion opportunities through additional services, compliance solutions, or operational improvements that create measurable client value.

·	Oversee renewal planning across the portfolio, ensuring renewals are initiated on time and handled with long-term client relationships in mind.

·	Maintain visibility into the team's expansion pipeline and forecast segment growth to leadership.

·	Ensure every recommendation the team makes aligns with the client's business needs and long-term success.

 

4. Portfolio Health & Team Performance Management

·	Own the overall health and performance of the core client portfolio.

·	Monitor client engagement, retention risks, service utilization, and satisfaction trends across the segment and by Account Manager.

·	Direct recovery strategies for at-risk accounts and coordinate cross-functional action plans.

·	Ensure the team maintains accurate account plans, forecasts, client documentation, and CRM records.

·	Report portfolio and team performance metrics to leadership and use insights to drive continuous improvement.

 

5. Cross-Functional Leadership & Process

·	Serve as the core portfolio's central point of coordination with internal teams.

·	Partner closely with Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Sales to ensure a consistent client experience.

·	Build and refine scalable account management processes, playbooks, and workflows that allow the team to serve a high volume of accounts efficiently.

·	Share customer insights to influence product enhancements, service improvements, and organizational priorities.

·	Advocate for client needs while balancing operational capabilities and business objectives.

Technical Skills:

•	Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret client and team performance metrics, identify trends, and develop strategic recommendations.

•	Experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, to prepare leadership reports, account reviews, and team performance insights.

•	Demonstrated ability to handle protected health information (PHI) and confidential client data in accordance with HIPAA and MedPro and MP1's information security policies.

•	Reliable high-speed internet, a private and secure workspace, and use of company-issued equipment and VPN for all client and system access.

•Executive Presence and Professionalism 

•Strategic Thinking 

•Customer-Centric Mindset

title: Head of Acquisition
description:
Role Overview



The Head of Acquisitions owns the entire cold calling operation the systems, the management layer, and the people. This is not a working-manager seat: it is for an operator who has already scaled an outbound calling floor past 30 agents and knows one person cannot review calls and train at that scale so they build team leads, QA systems, and accountability infrastructure that make performance visible without them in the room. Adrian, our current Director of Acquisitions, reports to this role.



Core Responsibilities

Systems and process architecture

• Design and document the full operating system for the calling floor: lead flow, batch assignment, dispositions, follow-up cadence, QA scorecards, schedules, and escalation paths

• Build the management layer: team leads and QA reviewers over pods of callers, so call review and training stay efficient as headcount grows and no single manager becomes the bottleneck.



Accountability — no one games the system

• Monitor Aloware dashboards daily: dials per hour, talk time, occupancy, and schedule adherence per caller.

• Detect and shut down time theft: idle gaps, ghost dialing, padded dispositions, and off-schedule work. Callers are on the right schedules for the markets they dial — verified in the data, not assumed.



Quality and training at scale

• Run a calibrated QA program: standardized scorecards, minimum review coverage per caller per week, and weekly calibration sessions with team leads.

• Own the training system: onboarding classes, ramp targets, and continuous retraining whenever the script or process changes.



A-players only

• Own the hiring engine: sourcing pipelines, mock-call auditions, and hiring in classes so churn never leaves seats empty.

• Enforce a tight performance bar: short improvement plans, fast exits. The roster holds only proven performers at every stage of scale.

Leadership and reporting

• Manage and develop the Director of Acquisitions (Adrian) and the team lead layer.

• Deliver a weekly operating report to the founder: activity, quality, pipeline, deals closed, and roster moves.



Ideal Candidate Profile

• 2+ years leading outbound call center or BPO operations, including scaling a telecom or similar cold calling operation past 30 agents.

• Has personally built the systems, not just used them: QA programs, workforce management and schedule adherence, activity dashboards, and anti-time-theft controls.

At Meadow, we’re reimagining end-of-life care - a $23B industry untouched by modern software or service thinking.
