About the Role

We’re hiring Family Case Managers to compassionately guide families through our full service lifecycle - from contract signature to the safe return of their loved one's ashes.



In this highly accountable role, you will take extreme ownership of a high-volume book of around 100 concurrent cases. As the primary point of contact, you'll coordinate with internal teams to seamlessly manage transportation, documentation, cremation scheduling, and ashes return.



While you fully own your caseload, ours is a highly collaborative startup. Our team works together to ensure no family experiences delays during peak volumes. The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, obsessed with the client experience, and a creative problem-solver comfortable navigating multiple systems to triage work and support others during a critical time.







What You’ll Do:

- Manage a high-volume book of business, overseeing the full client life cycle from contract signature through final resolution.

- Act as the dedicated point of contact, actively handling continuous inbound and outbound calls and texts throughout the workday with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.

- Guide families through each step of the process while building trust, rapport, and an exceptional overall client experience.

- Own key case milestones - transportation, documentation, cremation scheduling, ashes return - partnering with internal teams and vendors to keep cases moving.

-Keep documentation meticulous, updating all systems promptly and accurately.

- Seamlessly navigate across various platforms (HubSpot, Aircall, Slack, GSuite, internal case management system) to build case context, triage daily workflows, and solve problems efficiently.

- Collaborate with teammates to maintain continuity of care - assisting with coverage, escalations, and urgent case needs as volumes shift.

- Ensure smooth case handoffs and anticipate downstream impacts.



Requirements & Qualifications:

- 2+ years owning a caseload or book of accounts end-to-end - case management, patient or client coordination, claims handling, or similar.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Exceptional capacity for high volume: you can successfully manage 100+ cases simultaneously without letting details slip, and you are meticulous about record-keeping and documentation.

- Clear, calm communicator who builds trust quickly and is completely comfortable spending the majority of the workday managing communications via phone and text.

- Highly accountable and proactive: you take extreme ownership of your cases, obsess over the client experience, close the loop, and act as a creative problem solver when escalations arise.

- Tech-savvy and highly organized: you easily work across multiple systems to piece together context and effectively triage your daily priorities.

- Energized by our mission and excited about the opportunity to help shape something new in a category that truly needs it.

- A home setup that supports the work - see our tech requirements for details.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

- A serious employer for global teammates. We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.

- People stay. Regrettable turnover is very low. Don't take our word for it - read our Glassdoor reviews.

- High care, high standards. Real investment in training and growth, honest feedback, no burnout culture.

About Our Company



Promofect is a growing U.S.-based company with approximately $2+ million in annual revenue. We specialize in custom branded apparel, promotional products, and online merchandise stores.



We operate through two brands, Promofect and New York Rush Shirts, serving customers ranging from small businesses to large organizations. Our business combines B2B sales, e-commerce, in-house production, and outsourced manufacturing.



We're looking for an experienced accounting professional who can take ownership of our accounting operations, improve our financial systems, and help us build a stronger foundation for continued growth.



About the Opportunity



Currently, our accounting and finance functions are managed directly by the company owner, who has a professional background in accounting and finance.



We're looking for someone who can take over the day-to-day accounting responsibilities, maintain accurate financial records, develop better reporting, and continuously improve our processes.



The owner will continue overseeing higher-level financial strategy, but we want someone who can independently manage the accounting function without requiring constant supervision or technical accounting guidance.



We can teach you our business. We expect you to already know accounting.



We're not a large corporation with separate departments for every function. At our current size, this position requires someone comfortable wearing multiple hats, handling both detailed accounting work and broader financial projects.



As the company grows, some responsibilities may transition to additional team members. The right candidate will have the opportunity to help build the systems, procedures, and team that support a much larger business.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accounting & Financial Operations



• Take ownership of our daily accounting operations using QuickBooks Online.

• Manage transaction categorization, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

• Oversee 
, vendor payments, invoicing, and collections.

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and transactions from our various sales platforms.

• Manage month-end closing and maintain accurate financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Maintain accurate general ledger records and proper accrual accounting.

• Review existing accounting processes, identify errors or inefficiencies, and make improvements.

• Maintain strong financial controls and organized supporting documentation.



2. Financial Reporting & Analysis



• Prepare accurate daily sales and revenue reports across our different business channels.

• Maintain financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting.

• Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and budget-versus-actual analysis.

• Monitor cash flow, upcoming payments, and financial obligations.

• Develop reporting that helps us understand profitability by customer, order, product category, and business segment.

• Analyze order costs, including products, outsourced manufacturing, in-house production, and shipping.

• Work with management to improve our pricing models using actual financial results.

• Help connect revenue and profitability reporting with sales and marketing data.



3. Tax Compliance & Financial Administration



We have outside U.S. CPAs and tax professionals who handle our business income tax returns and provide specialized tax advice. You will coordinate with these professionals rather than replace them.



Responsibilities include:



• Manage ongoing sales tax reporting and filing processes across applicable U.S. states.

• Help maintain and improve sales tax compliance as the company grows.

• Recognize potential compliance issues and coordinate with outside advisors when needed.

• Manage W-9 collection and 1099 preparation and filing.

• Maintain accurate reporting for customer revenue-sharing programs and related payouts.

• Coordinate with outside accountants and tax professionals to ensure accurate and timely reporting.



4. Systems, Technology & Automation



We use several software platforms, including:



• QuickBooks Online

• 

• Printavo

• InkSoft

• Chipply



Some of these platforms support e-commerce and online merchandise stores, making accurate reconciliation and consolidated reporting especially important.



We want someone who is comfortable with technology and enthusiastic about improving processes.



Responsibilities include:



• Identify accounting tasks that can be simplified or automated.

• Use AI, automation tools, and software integrations to improve reporting, accuracy, and efficiency.

• Improve the flow of financial information between our systems.

• Build reliable, repeatable processes that reduce manual work.

• Continuously suggest and implement practical improvements.



Advanced AI development experience is not required. However, we expect you to already be using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your day-to-day accounting work, and to bring curiosity, strong technical aptitude, and a forward-looking approach to modern tools.



5. Payroll & Administrative Support



As a growing company, we also need flexibility across certain administrative and HR-related responsibilities.



You'll work alongside existing team members to help oversee:



• Employee time tracking and payroll processing.

• Sales commissions, bonuses, and incentive calculations.

• Payroll-related reconciliations and records.

• Employee administrative records and important milestones.

• Other finance-related administrative processes as needed.



These responsibilities may evolve or be delegated as the company grows.



Required Qualifications



• At least 5 years of professional accounting experience, including significant experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

• A stable career history, including at least 3 years in a single in-house role where you held real responsibility for a company's accounting (not freelance or multi-client bookkeeping).

• Active, hands-on use of AI tools in your current accounting work.

• Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting.

• Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

• Proven ability to independently manage full-cycle accounting and monthly closing.

• Experience preparing accurate financial statements and performing account reconciliations.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong attention to detail, accountability, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and make sound accounting decisions.



Preferred, but Not Required



• Experience as an Accounting Manager, Controller, Assistant Controller, or senior accountant with broad responsibilities.

• Experience in e-commerce, distribution, manufacturing, or order-based businesses.

• Experience with cost accounting, job costing, budgeting, and financial analysis.

• Familiarity with U.S. sales tax compliance.

• Experience with AI, automation, reporting tools, or software integrations.

• Experience improving accounting systems for a growing small business.

• Previous experience supervising or training accounting staff.



A CPA qualification is not required. Demonstrated accounting competence and real-world experience are more important to us.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership and improving the way things work.



We're looking for longevity. You've held an important accounting role within one company for several years, grew with that business, and were trusted with real responsibility. If your experience is mainly freelance work or outsourced bookkeeping across many small clients, this role is likely not the right fit.



You're forward-looking. You think ahead, anticipate problems before they happen, plan for growth, and already use AI and modern tools to work smarter.



You're comfortable handling everyday accounting transactions, but you also enjoy analyzing financial information, building better reports, and finding opportunities to improve the business.



You don't need to be an expert in every area of finance, technology, or tax. You do need to be resourceful, understand your responsibilities, recognize when specialized advice is needed, and take initiative to get things done.



We're especially interested in someone who has worked in a growing business and understands the need to balance day-to-day responsibilities with building better systems for the future.



We value independent thinking, accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and a willingness to continuously improve.



Growth Opportunity



This position will initially report directly to the company owner.



Our goal is to develop an organized, accurate, and efficient accounting function that can support the company as it grows.



Over time, you may have the opportunity to supervise additional accounting staff and take on broader responsibilities.



As the company expands, we may eventually introduce additional senior financial leadership. Our goal is for this position to remain an important part of a strong and scalable finance department.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow their career with us and become a valued, long-term member of our team.



This is a full-time position dedicated to our company, not a freelance opportunity. We're looking for someone ready to commit to one company for the long term.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and answer the following questions. We're looking for specific examples from your actual professional experience rather than generic responses.



1. Accounting Experience

Describe your experience managing accounting for U.S.-based companies. Have you independently handled the full accounting cycle, including monthly closing and financial statements?



2. Ownership & Problem-Solving

Tell us about a time you took over an accounting function, discovered problems, or improved existing processes. What did you personally accomplish?



3. Financial Reporting & Analysis

Describe your experience with budgeting, financial reporting, job costing, or profitability analysis. Have you built reports that helped management make better financial decisions?



4. Technology & Automation

Which AI tools do you use in your accounting work today, and how? Share a specific example of how AI, automation, or other technology improved an accounting process.



5. Working in a Growing Business

Are you comfortable being hands-on with daily accounting while also helping with payroll, reporting, and other administrative responsibilities as needed? Describe any similar experience.



6. Career Stability

What is the longest role you've held at a single company? How long were you there, what was your title, and what were you responsible for?



7. Compensation & Availability

What is your expected monthly salary in USD, and when would you be available to start?



We're looking for someone who can take ownership, deliver accurate work, improve our processes, and grow with our company. Qualified finalists may be asked to complete a paid practical accounting assessment.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Linton Co



Linton Co is looking for a highly organized, technical, and data-driven Marketing Operations Specialist to join our growing marketing team.



This role is responsible for the technical backbone of our marketing engine. You will manage marketing technology, build landing pages and forms, create funnels and automated follow-up sequences, implement tracking and analytics, and use performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.



This is an execution-focused role. You will take an established marketing strategy and be responsible for building it accurately, ensuring everything is properly tracked, and continuously improving the systems based on performance data.



You should be someone who enjoys working inside marketing platforms, troubleshooting systems, analyzing data, and making sure the details behind a campaign are working correctly from the first click through to the final conversion.



What You Will Do

Marketing Technology & Systems



You will serve as an internal resource for our marketing technology stack, particularly GoHighLevel for B2B marketing and Klaviyo for B2C marketing.



You will maintain contact databases, lists, integrations, deliverability, and overall platform organization. You will also identify opportunities to improve our existing technology stack and recommend new tools or solutions when they can improve efficiency, tracking, automation, or campaign performance.



Funnels, Landing Pages & Automation



You will build and maintain landing pages, forms, and multi-step marketing funnels for lead generation and campaigns.



You will connect landing pages and forms to the appropriate funnels and build automated
 and SMS sequences based on funnel stages, lead behavior, and other relevant triggers.



You will make sure leads move through the funnel correctly and receive the appropriate messaging at each stage.



You will troubleshoot issues such as leads not receiving follow-up messages, incorrect tagging, broken integrations, missing data, or other funnel-related problems.



You will also work closely with the sales team to understand lead quality and lead value and use that information to improve funnel logic, automation, and lead scoring.



Tracking, Analytics & Reporting



You will manage tracking and tagging across platforms including GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant marketing platforms.



You will ensure conversion events, pixels, UTMs, and other tracking mechanisms are properly implemented and consistently maintained across campaigns.



You will build and maintain reporting dashboards that clearly show marketing and funnel performance.



You will create data visualizations that make it easy to understand where leads originated, how they are progressing through the pipeline, and whether those leads ultimately generated revenue.



You will work with the sales team to connect closed revenue back to the original campaign, lead source, and marketing activity whenever possible.



You will regularly audit tracking and reporting systems to identify data gaps, inconsistencies, or discrepancies and take ownership of correcting them.



You will also document funnel logic, automation workflows, tracking configurations, and recurring processes through clear SOPs so that our systems are organized and scalable.



Optimization & Testing



You will analyze marketing and funnel performance to identify friction points, drop-off areas, conversion opportunities, and other areas where performance can be improved.



You will propose and execute A/B tests involving landing pages,
s, SMS campaigns, subject lines, funnel steps, messaging, and other campaign elements.



You will monitor test results, document findings, and make data-driven recommendations for future improvements.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone with at least 2 years of experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, CRM management, funnel management, or a similar role.



You should have hands-on experience with GoHighLevel and/or Klaviyo, or comparable platforms such as HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, or Marketo.



You should have practical experience building landing pages, forms, automated workflows, and multi-step marketing funnels.



You should have a working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, conversion tracking, pixels, and UTM tracking.



You should be comfortable working with campaign data and turning that information into specific, actionable recommendations.



Experience building dashboards and data visualizations using tools such as Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Tableau, or similar platforms is important.



You should be comfortable using AI tools to assist with building systems, analyzing data, creating reports, troubleshooting, and improving campaign performance.



Experience designing and running A/B tests is highly valuable.



Most importantly, you need to have strong attention to detail. This position is responsible for maintaining the accuracy of the marketing data and systems that the company relies on to make business decisions.



Nice to Have



Experience working with both B2B and B2C marketing campaigns is a plus.



Advanced Google Tag Manager experience, including server-side tracking, is a plus.



Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS for landing page customization is helpful.



Experience with SMS marketing and TCPA compliance is also a plus.



Who Will Succeed in This Role



The ideal candidate is technical, organized, analytical, and highly detail-oriented. You don't need to be the person creating the overall marketing strategy, but you need to be able to take a strategy and execute the technical components accurately.



You should enjoy solving problems, investigating why something is not working, working across multiple marketing platforms, and finding ways to make systems more efficient.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects and following through without needing constant supervision.



If you are someone who can build the system, verify that it is working, measure the results, identify what needs to improve, and implement those improvements, we would like to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please send your updated resume and portfolio to 
 portfolio should include examples of relevant marketing operations work, such as funnels, landing pages, automation workflows, dashboards, tracking implementations, campaign systems, or other projects that demonstrate your technical and analytical capabilities.



 Subject Line: LINTON MARKETING



Applications without an updated resume and portfolio may not be considered.



Please make sure your portfolio clearly shows your actual involvement in the projects you submit. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of systems you have built, marketing automation you have managed, tracking implementations, dashboards, funnel optimization, and measurable improvements you have contributed to.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Remote Director of Maintenance
description:
Green Ocean Property Management is a growing property-management organization serving residential rental and condominium/HOA portfolios, supported by related service businesses. Our maintenance operation must deliver fast, reliable service while controlling quality, labor, vendor capacity, billing, and client expectations.

Position Summary

The Maintenance Director is the senior functional leader responsible for maintenance performance across Green Ocean Property Management and Pro Services Boston. Reporting to the COO, this person owns service levels, field-team people management, project and coordination workflows, vendor capacity, department financial performance, and the systems required to deliver consistent work.

This is not primarily a dispatcher, technician, or individual project-manager role. The Director leads the maintenance function through clear scorecards, documented processes, direct management of the field team, and defined responsibilities for the Field Operations Specialist, Project Manager / Estimator, and Maintenance Coordination Team. The right person will make maintenance predictable, profitable, and less dependent on the CEO or COO for daily decisions.

Core Outcomes

Reliable service response: Emergency and routine requests are acknowledged, scheduled, and completed against approved service levels.

Controlled backlog: Every open item has a clear owner, status, next action, and escalation path; aged work is reduced and kept within approved limits.

Profitable maintenance delivery: Labor, vendor cost, billing completeness, project margin, and rework are measured and actively managed.

Consistent field quality: Inspections, workmanship standards, documentation, callbacks, and quality reviews are built into the operating process.

Clear people accountability: Field staff receive direct expectations, coaching, performance follow-up, and capacity planning from the Maintenance Director.

Scalable systems: Intake, coordination, project delivery, field execution, vendor management, and owner/property-manager handoffs are documented and repeatable.

Key Responsibilities

Maintenance Operations Leadership

Own the maintenance operating system from request intake through scheduling, field execution, documentation, billing handoff, and closeout.

Set emergency and routine service levels, escalation rules, quality standards, and communication expectations.

Run weekly maintenance operating reviews covering backlog, aging, scheduled work, emergencies, callbacks, staffing, vendor capacity, and financial performance.

Ensure the Maintenance Coordination Team maintains accurate work-order status, scheduling, resident communication, vendor communication, and after-hours handoffs.

Hold the Project Manager / Estimator accountable for scopes, estimates, schedules, project delivery, change control, documentation, and project margins.

Use the Field Operations Specialist for inspections, technical troubleshooting, difficult jobs, field recommendations, and workmanship checks without assigning people-management duties to that role.

Maintain complete, decision-ready records in PropertyMeld, Buildium, approved trackers, and related source systems.

Field Team and People Leadership

Directly manage field staff, including performance expectations, schedules, coaching, attendance, discipline, development, and staffing decisions.

Define required skills, productivity expectations, quality standards, safety practices, and documentation requirements for each field role.

Build labor and vendor capacity plans that match seasonal demand, portfolio growth, emergency coverage, and project commitments.

Identify performance issues early, document expectations, and complete timely follow-up rather than allowing unresolved problems to move upward to the COO.

Create practical onboarding and training plans for field staff, coordinators, estimators, and vendors.

Maintain a span of control that is workable at current headcount and recommend another frontline leadership seat only when workload and staffing data justify it.

Financial and Vendor Leadership

Own the maintenance budget, labor plan, vendor plan, gross-margin review, billing completeness, and material cost controls.

Ensure all billable labor, materials, vendor costs, estimates, approvals, and change orders are documented and handed to Finance on time.

Review vendor performance, pricing, availability, insurance requirements, service quality, and replacement risk.

Partner with Finance to reconcile operational activity with billing, payroll, vendor bills, receivables, and department reporting.

Identify unprofitable work types, repeated callbacks, underbilling, capacity gaps, and process failures, then bring a corrective recommendation to the COO.

Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the COO's accountable leader for maintenance outcomes and risks.

Coordinate with Property Operations, Leasing, Customer Success, On Ramp, Finance, and Systems/Data on handoffs that cross departments.

Convert maintenance data into a short executive do-list with an owner, deadline, metric, and expected business effect.

Build and maintain maintenance playbooks for routine work, emergencies, projects, inspections, vendor use, resident communication, and billing handoff.

Identify risks early and bring a recommendation, not only a problem, to the COO and CEO.

Decision Authority and Boundaries

The Maintenance Director is expected to improve routine maintenance processes, manage staff and vendors, enforce approved controls and deadlines, assign work, resolve routine escalations, and make day-to-day operating decisions within approved policies and budgets.

The Director prepares evidence-based recommendations for executive approval on material unbudgeted commitments, senior hires or terminations, major vendor changes, significant pricing or policy changes, legal or safety matters, and other decisions reserved for the COO or CEO. The Director owns maintenance management and results. The role should not depend on personally performing routine field work or redoing coordinator and project-manager tasks.

Proposed Scorecard

Final targets should be confirmed during the first 30 days after reviewing the current baseline.

Emergency and routine service requests meet approved acknowledgment, scheduling, and completion standards.

Aged work orders remain within approved limits, and every material exception has an owner, next action, and date.

Scheduled work, field productivity, project delivery, and vendor capacity are reported weekly.

Billing documentation, labor, material, estimate, approval, and change-order records are complete and timely.

Callbacks, rework, quality defects, safety issues, and repeated failures are measured and reduced against baseline.

Field staff, the Project Manager / Estimator, Field Operations Specialist, and Maintenance Coordination Team deliver their scorecards without the Director redoing their work.

First 90 Days

First 30 Days - Diagnose and Establish Control

Review the maintenance organization, open roles, direct-report capabilities, workload, current vendors, and existing scorecards.

Assess PropertyMeld data, backlog, aging, emergencies, callbacks, projects, estimates, billing handoffs, margin reporting, and field capacity.

Confirm decision rights for the Field Operations Specialist, Project Manager / Estimator, Maintenance Coordination Team, and field staff.

Identify material client, safety, staffing, vendor, financial, and key-person risks.

Agree with the COO on the final scorecard, reporting cadence, approval limits, and escalation rules.

Days 31-60 - Install the Operating Cadence

Launch one weekly maintenance operating review and one monthly financial and capacity review.

Publish service levels, backlog definitions, escalation rules, quality checks, and communication standards.

Implement direct-report scorecards and regular one-on-ones.

Create the field and vendor capacity plan and assign owners to the highest-risk gaps.

Document the required workflow from intake through billing handoff and closeout.

Days 61-90 - Demonstrate Independent Execution

Run a complete maintenance operating cycle without relying on the CEO or COO for daily decisions.

Show measurable movement in aged backlog, scheduling reliability, quality, billing completeness, and team accountability.

Present a 12-month maintenance improvement plan ranked by business impact, risk, effort, cost, and owner.

Demonstrate that field staff and supporting roles operate against clear metrics and decision rights.

Required Qualifications

Significant progressive experience leading maintenance, facilities, construction service, field operations, or a comparable multi-site service function.

Proven people-management experience, including performance expectations, coaching, discipline, hiring, staffing, and direct accountability for a field team.

Working knowledge of work-order operations, emergency response, estimating, project delivery, vendor management, quality control, and safety practices.

Experience owning a department budget, labor capacity, vendor cost, billing completeness, and operating metrics.

Ability to distinguish technical expertise from people leadership and assign each responsibility to the correct role.

Strong written and verbal communication, follow-through, documentation, and comfort holding staff, vendors, and peers accountable.

Experience with property-management, maintenance-management, scheduling, reporting, and collaboration systems.

Ability to lead a distributed team across field and remote functions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in residential property management, condominium/HOA management, multifamily operations, or an in-house maintenance business.

Experience with PropertyMeld, Buildium, QuickBooks Online, Google Workspace, and workflow or reporting automation.

Experience improving response time, backlog aging, gross margin, billing completeness, vendor capacity, callbacks, or field productivity with measurable results.

Relevant trade, construction-management, facilities, project-management, or safety qualification.

Benefits and Time Off

Benefits for this full-time role include:

Health insurance: Employer-sponsored health coverage. Eligibility, plan terms, and the employer contribution are governed by the applicable benefit plan and offer letter.

Paid time off (PTO): 15 paid days annually, subject to company policy.

Paid sick time: 5 paid days annually, subject to company policy and applicable law.

Paid holidays, subject to the company holiday calendar.

Leadership Profile

Leads through clear outcomes rather than constant task supervision.

Creates practical controls without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Uses source data before drawing conclusions and distinguishes urgent work from high-value work.

Solves recurring problems through ownership, process, and systems.

Coaches people while holding a firm performance standard.

Communicates bad news early, plainly, and with a recommended next step.

Equal Opportunity

Green Ocean Property Management is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without unlawful discrimination.



Internal Hiring Note

Because this role directly manages field staff and leads several specialized functions, the hiring process should test people leadership, maintenance operations, financial judgment, vendor management, and the ability to build systems without personally taking over every task. Technical maintenance knowledge without proven people accountability is not sufficient.

Role Performance Metrics

Primary scorecard. Targets are recommended starting points and should be confirmed against the current baseline during the first 30 days.

#

Metric

Target

Measurement source

1

Emergency response control

100% of emergency requests acknowledged within the approved emergency SLA; every missed SLA has a documented cause and corrective action.

PropertyMeld emergency reports and escalation log.

2

Aged backlog control

100% of work older than the approved aging threshold has an owner, next action, and due date; aged backlog improves against the confirmed baseline.

PropertyMeld backlog and aging reports.

3

Schedule reliability

At least 90% of scheduled work is completed by the promised date, excluding documented access, approval, or scope-change delays.

PropertyMeld schedule, completion records, and exception reasons.

4

Billing and margin control

100% of billable labor, materials, vendor costs, approvals, and change orders are documented and submitted on time; department margin is reviewed monthly.

PropertyMeld, time records, vendor bills, Buildium, and finance reporting.

5

Quality and team accountability

Callbacks and rework remain within the approved target; 100% of required scorecards, one-on-ones, reviews, and documented performance follow-ups are completed on time.

Quality reviews, callback log, manager scorecards, and HR records.



Ownership standard: The Director owns these results through field staff, the Project Manager / Estimator, Field Operations Specialist, and Maintenance Coordination Team. Results should reflect independent team performance rather than work the Director personally completed or redid.

Green Ocean Property Management (GOPM) is hiring a detail-driven and proactive Property Manager Assistant to support the daily operations of our property management team. In this role, you will be instrumental in maintaining tenant satisfaction, ensuring smooth leasing processes, and coordinating with vendors and internal teams to address property needs.



This is a client-facing, systems-heavy role that requires strong organization, responsiveness, and communication skills. You’ll handle the front lines of tenant communication, assist with maintenance logistics, and contribute to streamlined operational execution — all from a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Tenant Communication & Lease Management

Act as the primary point of contact for tenants — address inquiries, requests, and concerns in a timely, professional manner.

Assist in lease lifecycle management including drafting lease agreements, facilitating renewals, and processing terminations.

Manage rent collection activities, send reminders, escalate late payments, and help enforce payment terms.



Maintenance Coordination

Serve as liaison between tenants, property owners, and vendors.

Schedule and monitor maintenance and repair work orders using internal tracking tools.

Ensure follow-through and resolution of service requests; maintain a high standard of property condition.



Records Management

Maintain up-to-date digital records including leases, inspection reports, rent rolls, and maintenance logs.

Ensure compliance with state and federal property management regulations regarding documentation and tenant interactions.



Tenant Screening & Onboarding

Conduct background checks, verify employment and references for prospective tenants.

Assist in preparing onboarding materials and move-in documentation.



Move-In/Move-Out Support

Assist in the coordination of property inspections for both move-ins and move-outs.

Prepare condition reports and coordinate with vendors for turnover services.

Ensure timely processing of security deposit returns in accordance with regulations.



Reporting & Data Entry

Generate regular operational reports, including:

Occupancy/vacancy rates

Maintenance activity summaries

Rent collection status

Lease expiration schedules

Flag operational risks or trends proactively.



Marketing & Listings Support

Create or update rental listings on platforms such as Zillow,
 Marketplace, and RentRedi.

Coordinate with the leasing team to schedule virtual or in-person property showings.

Monitor listing performance and suggest optimizations.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with the property management, leasing, and accounting teams to ensure efficient workflow.

Escalate urgent issues while maintaining alignment with internal processes and SOPs.

Suggest process improvements that enhance tenant experience or team productivity.



Qualifications:

Minimum 2 years experience in property management, real estate operations, or virtual property assistance.

Knowledge of lease administration, rental laws, and maintenance coordination processes.

Ability to multitask across a high volume of properties or tenants.

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) and professional customer service demeanor.





Technical Proficiency

Strong experience with property management software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, RentRedi, or similar).

Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar) and Microsoft Office.

Comfortable using remote tools like Slack, Zoom, and project management boards (Asana, Trello).

title: Phone sales, Appointment setting, Go-High-Level Admin
description:
# Phone Sales, Appointment Setting & Service Coordinator

**Company:** Florida Pure Water Services  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  

**Compensation:** Base Pay + Commissions + Performance Bonuses



## About Us



Florida Pure Water Services is a growing water filtration and water treatment company serving homeowners throughout Central Florida. We install water softeners, reverse osmosis drinking water systems, whole-home filtration systems, and well-water treatment systems. We also provide maintenance, repairs, and annual water care plans.



We are looking for an experienced, dependable, and sales-oriented Phone Sales & Customer Service Coordinator to handle incoming calls, follow up with leads, schedule appointments, sell services and maintenance plans, collect payments, and manage customer information in GoHighLevel (GHL).



We need someone who can communicate naturally with American homeowners, confidently guide sales conversations, stay organized, and help manage daily operations without constant supervision.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Phone Sales & Lead Follow-Up

- Answer incoming calls from homeowners interested in water filtration and softener systems.

- Call new leads promptly after they submit an inquiry.

- Follow up with leads from Google,
, the company website, and other marketing sources.

- Make outbound calls to old leads, past customers, and prospective customers.

- Ask qualifying questions, identify the customer's water concerns, and explain our services.

- Discuss system options and pricing confidently using company-approved scripts and pricing sheets.

- Help customers understand the value of professional sizing, installation, and ongoing service.

- Follow up on estimates and previous inquiries to help close sales.

- Transfer qualified opportunities to the owner or designated sales representative when needed.

- Record every call, conversation, outcome, and next step in GHL.



### 2. Appointment Setting

- Schedule complimentary water-test appointments for qualified homeowners within our approved service area.

- Confirm the customer's address, phone number, water type, and reason for requesting service.

- Confirm that the homeowner and all relevant decision-makers can attend the appointment.

- Schedule appointments on the company calendar and send confirmations and reminders.

- Reschedule missed appointments and follow up with customers who do not answer.

- Qualify leads located outside the normal service area and route them for phone pricing or further review.

- Maintain accurate appointment notes so the sales representative knows what to expect.



### 3. Service Scheduling & Customer Support

- Answer calls from existing customers requesting repairs, maintenance, filter changes, or troubleshooting.

- Schedule service appointments for water systems of various makes and models, subject to our service-area and scheduling guidelines.

- Explain the company's service options and approved fees.

- Offer the Annual Water Care Plan when appropriate.

- Schedule diagnostic visits, maintenance appointments, and return service calls.

- Confirm service appointments and communicate changes to customers and technicians.

- Collect relevant system information, including brand, model, installation history, symptoms, and photos when needed.

- Follow up with customers after service to ensure records are updated and any next steps are documented.



### 4. GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM Management

- Manage contacts, opportunities, pipelines, calendars, tasks, and customer records.

- Enter accurate customer information and maintain clean, organized data.

- Update lead statuses and record call notes, appointment results, sales outcomes, and follow-up dates.

- Use approved workflows, reminders, and follow-up campaigns.

- Monitor new leads and make sure no inquiries are overlooked.

- Track appointments, cancellations, no-shows, service requests, and sales opportunities.

- Help reactivate older leads and follow up with past customers.

- Learn company procedures and assist with improving CRM organization as the business grows.



**Previous GoHighLevel experience is strongly preferred.** Applicants must be comfortable learning new workflows and using a CRM throughout the workday.



### 5. Payments, Data Entry & Administrative Tasks

- Process customer payments through the company's approved payment systems.

- Record payments accurately and confirm that transactions are properly documented.

- Send receipts and payment confirmations when required.

- Enter service charges, maintenance-plan purchases, deposits, and other approved transactions.

- Maintain accurate records of invoices, appointments, customer information, and sales activity.

- Follow company procedures for payment authorization, refunds, and billing questions.

- Never store or transmit customer payment-card information outside approved systems.

- Prepare daily activity reports covering calls, appointments, sales, service bookings, payments, and outstanding follow-ups.



### 6. Annual Water Care Plan Sales

- Explain the benefits of the Annual Water Care Plan to eligible customers.

- Contact existing customers who may need maintenance or an updated service plan.

- Follow up on plan renewals and customer questions.

- Record new plan sales and renewal information accurately in GHL.



The current Annual Water Care Plan price is **$399 per year**, subject to company pricing and eligibility guidelines.



## Required Qualifications



- Fluent spoken and written English, with clear, natural-sounding American English pronunciation suitable for speaking with U.S. homeowners.

- Excellent listening comprehension and the ability to understand customers speaking at a normal pace.

- Professional phone etiquette, a friendly manner, and confidence in handling customer questions.

- Previous experience in phone sales, appointment setting, customer service, or call-center operations.

- Experience handling inbound leads and making outbound follow-up calls.

- GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- Comfortable using calendars, spreadsheets, payment systems, and customer databases.

- Strong data-entry accuracy and attention to detail.

- Able to follow scripts while still sounding natural and conversational.

- Organized, dependable, coachable, and able to work independently.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset.

- Must be available during agreed-upon U.S. business hours.



## Mandatory Voice Recording



**Applicants without a voice recording will not be considered.**



Please submit a 60–90 second recording in your own natural voice. Record it using your phone or computer. AI-generated or dubbed recordings are not accepted.



In the recording:



1. Introduce yourself and describe your relevant experience.

2. Explain your experience with phone sales, appointment setting, customer service, and GoHighLevel.

3. Pretend a homeowner calls and asks: “How much does a water softener cost?” Respond as if you were speaking to a real customer.

4. Explain how you would handle a customer who calls because their existing water softener is not working correctly.



We will evaluate English pronunciation and comprehension, clarity, professionalism, confidence, listening ability, and how naturally you handle customer conversations.



Please submit your résumé, desired hourly rate, availability, and details about your previous phone-based work.



## Compensation: Base Pay + Commissions





- **$50 per qualifying system sale** attributed to your sales efforts and confirmed under company commission rules.



- **$15 per Annual Water Care Plan sold** and recorded correctly in GHL.

- **$1,000 monthly sales bonus** for achieving 20 qualifying system sales in a calendar month, subject to management verification and the written bonus terms

- Additional weekly incentives may be offered for strong performance.



All commissions must be documented in GHL and will be paid according to the company's written commission policy. Appointment and sales credit rules will be explained during training.



## Work Schedule



- Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM–7:00 PM Eastern Time, with the agreed shift and breaks established before hiring.

- Saturday coverage may be required by mutual agreement.

- No Sunday calling unless specifically approved.



The role requires dependable attendance during scheduled hours because new leads and customer service calls must be handled promptly.



## Performance Expectations



Successful team members will be measured on:



- Speed of response to new leads.

- Calls completed and follow-ups properly documented.

- Qualified appointments booked and attended.

- System sales and Annual Water Care Plans sold.

- Service appointments booked accurately.

- Payment and data-entry accuracy.

- Customer communication and professionalism.

- Reliability, organization, and adherence to company procedures.



## Who We Are Looking For



We want a long-term team member who takes ownership, communicates clearly, learns quickly, and understands that every customer interaction matters.



The right person can confidently speak with homeowners, help turn inquiries into appointments and sales, schedule service efficiently, maintain accurate CRM records, and keep daily operations running smoothly.



**If you are comfortable on the phone, have strong English communication skills, understand CRM systems, and enjoy helping a growing business succeed, we want to hear from you.**

𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗨𝘀:

Hi, I'm Harry, founder of AddSomeAI, a UK-based AI and automation development firm. We're among the longest running AI developers in the field.



We work directly with business owners, identify their biggest opportunities, and build tailored solutions to drive growth. We are experienced and confident in delivering bespoke solutions with AI and automation - now, we need someone to help us share that excitement with the world through video content to help it scale as well as take on creative edits for some of our clients.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲:

Each week I'll send you a talking-head video, filmed on one camera, showing business owners practical ways to use AI, along with screen recordings of the tools in action. You'll trim it into a tight story, then build in the graphics that make each idea easy to follow. After that, you'll turn the best moments into Shorts and Reels, d
 how many each video can carry.



We posted 20 videos on our YouTube channel last year, then had to pause for six months due to workload. It's early days, and now we need an editor to get us back to posting every week. If you've edited talking-head YouTube videos for creators, coaches or businesses, you'll feel right at home.



• 𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗹: 

• 𝗪𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝘄𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗵𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴: 



You'll not only be creating innovative edits, but you'll also have the creative freedom to experiment with video concepts you think will grow the channel and dare we say it 'go viral!'. We want videos that not only help business owners but motivate them to take action to improve their business.



We use AI to speed up the slower parts of editing, like transcripts, rough cuts and captions, and to help visualise business ideas, such as turning a concept into a clear visual. We're not looking for fully AI-generated videos. We'll be happy to help you keep up with the latest in AI, but it won't replace the creative and story telling eye from an editor we are looking for.



Here are a few of the edits we are looking for:

• 

• 

• 

• 



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗢𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆:

You'll work directly with the founder, gaining senior-level exposure to how a start-up scales. The role starts as flexible, part-time freelance work, project by project. We plan to increase the hours as we go and look to make this full time if we're happy with your work.



One video a week may grow to two, and we're planning to offer editing to our clients too, so there's more work to come.



We think big, grow together and celebrate wins.



𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:

• 𝗟𝗼𝗻𝗴-𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗺 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗧𝘂𝗯𝗲: Take full ownership of each video from raw footage to final delivery, usually 6 to 15 minutes long. That means a strong opening, a clear story with the repetition cut out, and an ending that lands.

• 𝗩𝗶𝘀𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴: Kinetic text with sound effects, simple diagrams and icons, zooms and highlights on the screen recordings, and B-roll or images that illustrate each point, all matching our tone and brand.

• 𝗠𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗰: Choose and cut music that matches the mood and narrative of the story. We want people to feel something and come away motivated to take action in their business.

• 𝗦𝗵𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗥𝗲𝗲𝗹𝘀: Choose which moments work as Shorts and Reels, then give each one a new hook, vertical crop and captions. If an idea would work better filmed on its own, suggest it and I'll record it.

• 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗙𝗿𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗼𝗺: Pitch your own concepts and hooks, and try new formats and editing styles. If you think something will work better, we want to hear it!



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴:

• Experience editing talking-head YouTube videos, with examples you can share.

• Competence in Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing software.

• A storyteller's eye. You can find the story in the raw footage and keep people watching to the end.

• Clean finishing: clear speech, consistent audio levels, balanced colour and captions that are easy to read.

• Reliability, attention to detail and the ability to deliver to strict deadlines.

𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆:

title: Full-Time Amazon PPC Manager & Listing Optimization Specialist
description:
We are looking for a skilled, analytical, and results-oriented **Amazon PPC Manager who also understands Amazon listing optimization**.



Your primary responsibility will be to independently manage and optimize our Amazon advertising campaigns, initially focusing on Amazon USA and Canada. You will also help optimize product listings, particularly titles and bullet points, to improve keyword relevance, discoverability, and conversion performance.



You should be willing to support the Canadian marketplace also.



We need someone with genuine, hands-on experience managing real Amazon advertising campaigns. Watching courses or completing certifications alone is not sufficient.



You should be able to analyze data, identify opportunities, make independent decisions, implement optimizations, and explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of PPC performance without requiring daily instructions.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Amazon PPC Campaign Management



Independently create, manage, analyze, and optimize:



- Sponsored Products

- Sponsored Brands

- Sponsored Display

- Automatic and manual campaigns

- Keyword and product targeting

- Competitor targeting

- Campaign creation, structuring, and restructuring

- Bid optimization and budget allocation

- Placement optimization

- Search-term report analysis

- Keyword harvesting and negative keyword management

- Campaign scaling and performance improvement

- Identification and reduction of wasted advertising spend



### 2. PPC Performance and Profitability Analysis



- Monitor ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and other relevant metrics.

- Identify profitable keywords, targets, and campaigns that can be scaled.

- Investigate underperforming campaigns and determine the causes.

- Recommend and implement data-driven changes to bids, budgets, targeting, and campaign structure.

- Balance advertising efficiency, sales growth, and overall profitability.

- Analyze advertising performance alongside total sales and organic sales trends when data is available.

- Avoid making decisions based on ACoS alone without considering broader business objectives.



### 3. Amazon Listing Optimization



Help improve product listings to support organic visibility and conversion rates.



- Optimize product titles using relevant keywords while maintaining readability and compliance with Amazon policies.

- Improve bullet points to communicate product benefits, features, and selling points clearly.

- Conduct keyword research and competitor listing analysis.

- Identify listing weaknesses that may affect clicks or conversions.

- Recommend improvements based on advertising data, keyword relevance, customer intent, and conversion performance.

- Monitor listing performance after changes and recommend further improvements where appropriate.



### 4. Amazon Marketing Knowledge



Working knowledge of the broader Amazon marketing ecosystem, including:



- Amazon Brand Analytics

- Amazon Attribution

- Promotions, Coupons, and Deals

- Keyword research and Amazon SEO

- Competitor analysis

- Listing quality and conversion-rate analysis



Experience with Amazon DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a plus, but not mandatory.



### 5. Amazon Canada



You will help with:



- Setting up and optimizing Amazon Canada advertising campaigns.

- Conducting Canada-specific keyword and competitor research.

- Adapting PPC strategies to the Canadian marketplace.

- Reviewing listing titles and bullet points for Canadian search behavior and marketplace requirements.

- Monitoring performance and identifying growth opportunities.



Previous Amazon Canada experience is an advantage, but strong Amazon USA PPC experience and the ability to learn and adapt are more important.



### 6. Weekly Reporting and Recommendations



Prepare a clear weekly report covering:



- Advertising spend, sales, and performance trends.

- ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, and other relevant metrics.

- Campaigns and keywords performing well or poorly.

- Wasted spend and corrective actions.

- Optimization activities completed.

- Listing optimization opportunities.

- Recommended actions for the following week.



Reports must explain what happened, why it happened, what actions were taken, and what should happen next. Simply submitting spreadsheets of numbers is not sufficient.



### 7. Independent Ownership



You will be expected to manage PPC activities independently, prioritize tasks, identify problems, and implement appropriate optimizations.



We expect you to communicate proactively and take responsibility for your work rather than wait for instructions for every decision.



## Required Qualifications



- Minimum 2 year of practical Amazon PPC experience.

- Hands-on experience managing real Amazon advertising campaigns.

- Experience with Amazon USA.

- Practical knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

- Strong understanding of keyword targeting, bid optimization, search-term analysis, negative keywords, and budget management.

- Good understanding of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rate.

- Ability to analyze PPC data and make independent decisions.

- Knowledge of Amazon listing optimization, especially titles and bullet points.

- Ability to conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

- Ability to prepare weekly reports and actionable recommendations.

- Good written English communication and comfort with video calls.

- Reliability, attention to detail, and a proactive attitude.



**Practical experience and demonstrated ability matter more than certificates.** Candidates who have only watched Amazon PPC courses without meaningful hands-on experience will not be considered.



## Preferred Qualifications



Experience with tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, Pacvue, Perpetua, or similar platforms is an advantage.



Experience with Amazon Canada, Amazon DSP, AMC, or additional marketplaces is also an advantage, but these are not mandatory.



## Who Should Not Apply



Please do not apply if:



- You have only watched Amazon PPC courses without practical campaign-management experience.

- You have never personally managed real Amazon advertising campaigns.

- You can only follow instructions and cannot independently analyze data.

- You cannot explain the reasoning behind your optimization decisions.

- Your experience is limited to creating campaigns without ongoing management.

- You cannot provide a genuine example of work you personally performed.

- You require constant supervision for routine tasks.



## Application Instructions — Please Read Carefully



We receive many generic applications and copy-paste introductions. We want to identify candidates who have actually read and understood this job post.



**Start your application with the exact words:**



### USA FIRST —



Immediately after these words, write one original sentence explaining why your hands-on Amazon PPC experience makes you suitable for this position.



Your sentence must mention at least one PPC activity you have personally performed.



Do not copy a sentence from this job post or submit a generic introduction. Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be considered.



## Application Questions



Please answer all the following questions along with your resume.



**1. Practical experience:** How many years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience do you have?



**2. Marketplaces:** Which Amazon marketplaces have you personally managed advertising campaigns for? Please specify your Amazon USA experience.



**3. Advertising spend:** What is the highest approximate monthly Amazon advertising spend you have personally managed?



**4. Campaign types:** Which campaign types have you personally managed: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, or others?



**5. Real-world results:** Describe one Amazon PPC account you personally managed. Include the initial situation, actions you took, approximate timeframe, advertising spend where possible, and measurable results. Do not disclose confidential client information.



**6. Independent decision-making:** In 2–3 sentences, explain what you understand your main responsibilities will be in this position.

title: SQL Database Report Administrator
description:
About the Role



Are you passionate about data management, relational database architecture, and helping organizations transform complex data into actionable business intelligence? We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SQL Database Report Administrator to join our team and contribute to our data strategy and reporting infrastructure.



In this role, you will help design, optimize, and maintain database environments (with a focus on MySQL and relational systems), build robust reporting solutions, and ensure high availability and accuracy across our enterprise data systems. We are looking for someone who combines analytical thinking, deep technical knowledge, and problem-solving skills to support business-critical operations.



If you enjoy analyzing complex datasets, writing optimized queries, building interactive reports, and ensuring seamless database performance, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities



- Report Development & Design: Design, build, schedule, and maintain complex operational reports, interactive dashboards, and business performance metrics tailored to stakeholder needs.



- MySQL Database Administration & Maintenance: Manage, monitor, and maintain MySQL and relational databases to ensure optimal performance, data integrity, and uptime.



- Query Optimization & Performance Tuning: Write, refactor, and optimize complex SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and indexes to improve response times and streamline reporting queries.



- Data Integration & Pipeline Management: Support data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) processes to aggregate data from multiple systems into unified reporting repositories.



- Database Security & Access Control: Manage user permissions, role-based access, and security configurations to protect sensitive data while maintaining easy access for authorized reporting.



- Data Audits & Quality Control: Conduct regular data audits, validate report metrics against raw database sources, troubleshoot discrepancies, and ensure overall data accuracy.



- Backup & Disaster Recovery: Execute routine database backups, recovery testing, and maintenance scripts to guarantee continuous data availability for key business metrics.



- Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Proactively track database metrics, identify system bottlenecks, and resolve technical issues affecting query and report generation speed.



- Stakeholder Collaboration & Documentation: Translate business requirements into functional data models, document database schemas and report definitions, and communicate insights to non-technical teams.



- Industry Trends & Modern Practices: Stay informed on advancements in MySQL administration, reporting platforms, cloud environments, and business intelligence practices.



- Qualifications and Requirements

Proven experience in reporting, business intelligence (BI), or database reporting administration.

- Strong hands-on experience with MySQL (or similar relational database management systems) and advanced SQL query writing.

- Demonstrated background creating, modifying, and automating reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or dedicated reporting suites.

- Solid understanding of relational database design, indexing strategies, data aggregation, and query performance tuning.

- Ability to analyze complex data structures and convert raw operational data into actionable insights for business leaders.

- Strong technical, analytical, and troubleshooting capabilities.

- Exceptional attention to detail and data validation skills.

- Effective written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple reporting priorities, work independently, and collaborate across cross-functional departments.



Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with MySQL optimization tools (e.g., EXPLAIN execution plans, slow query logs, MySQL Workbench).

- Proficiency in scripting languages (such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for reporting task automation and data processing.

- Experience with cloud database services (e.g., AWS RDS for MySQL, Google Cloud SQL, or Azure Database for MySQL).

- Knowledge of data warehousing models (e.g., star/snowflake schemas) optimized for high-performance reporting.

- Experience managing replication, high availability, or backup strategies for MySQL databases.

- Relevant industry certifications (e.g., MySQL Database Administrator certification, Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst, or Tableau Certified).



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a proactive professional who takes initiative, enjoys solving complex data challenges, and is committed to delivering accurate, actionable reporting. The ideal candidate can identify database bottlenecks, build scalable reporting frameworks, and contribute to strategies that drive data-informed decision-making.

We value accountability, collaboration, adaptability, and a results-oriented mindset.



How to Apply

If you have the technical skills and reporting experience to contribute to our business intelligence initiatives, we would love to hear from you.



Submit your updated résumé highlighting your relevant MySQL experience, reporting tools, and database administration accomplishments. Candidates whose qualifications align with the role will be considered for the next steps in our recruitment process.



Ready to take the next step in your data and reporting career? Apply today and become part of our team!

**Position:** CRM & Automation Specialist / Technical Operations VA  

**Schedule:** Full-Time, 40 Hours Per Week | US Eastern Time Overlap Required  

**Compensation:** Competitive Monthly Salary Based on Experience



## About Localstradegy



Localstradegy is a growing US-based AI automation, marketing technology, and SaaS company serving small and medium-sized businesses, with a strong focus on home service contractors.



We help businesses capture more opportunities, automate customer communications, manage leads, improve follow-up, and streamline their operations through CRM systems, AI-powered tools, and marketing automation.



Our primary platform is **Votel.ai**, which provides CRM, automation, funnels, websites, AI agents, and business-management functionality.



We are expanding our technical operations team and looking for a highly experienced **Votel or GoHighLevel Specialist** who can take ownership of customer onboarding, account configuration, funnel development, workflow automation, integrations, and ongoing technical support.



**This is NOT an entry-level virtual assistant position.**



We need someone who understands how these systems work, can build independently, troubleshoot problems, and take a project from initial requirements through successful implementation.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### Client Onboarding & Account Setup



- Set up and configure new customer accounts and subaccounts.

- Complete technical onboarding for new clients.

- Configure business profiles, users, permissions, and account settings.

- Set up CRM pipelines, opportunity stages, contact fields, tags, and segmentation.

- Connect calendars, appointment scheduling, forms, and lead capture systems.

- Configure phone numbers,
 services, and communication settings.

- Assist with domain connections and DNS-related configuration.

- Test each account thoroughly before customer handoff.

- Maintain onboarding checklists and document completed work.



### Funnel & Website Development



- Build professional landing pages and conversion-focused sales funnels.

- Create lead capture forms, surveys, booking pages, and thank-you pages.

- Connect funnels to CRM pipelines and automation workflows.

- Configure conversion tracking and lead-source attribution.

- Update existing websites and funnels as needed.

- Troubleshoot broken forms, buttons, redirects, and integrations.

- Ensure pages work correctly on desktop and mobile.



We value clean, professional, conversion-focused work—not generic templates with minimal customization.



### Workflow Automation



You must be highly proficient in building and troubleshooting automated workflows.



Responsibilities include:



- Lead capture and routing

- Missed-call text-back

- Automated lead follow-up

- Appointment confirmations and reminders

- Review request automation

- Database reactivation campaigns

- Customer onboarding sequences

- Pipeline stage automations

- Internal notifications

- Conditional logic and branching

- Tags, triggers, filters, and custom fields

- Webhooks and third-party integrations

- Error handling and workflow testing



You must understand how different workflows interact and how to prevent duplicate messages, conflicting triggers, and broken customer journeys.



### AI Agents & Business Automation



Help configure, test, and maintain AI-powered communication systems, including:



- AI receptionists

- Voice agents

- Conversational AI

- Appointment-setting assistants

- Lead qualification workflows

- Escalation and handoff procedures

- AI prompt configuration

- Knowledge-base setup

- Testing and troubleshooting



Prior experience with AI voice agents is highly desirable.



### Integrations & Technical Troubleshooting



- Configure webhooks and supported API integrations.

- Connect external websites and forms to the CRM.

- Troubleshoot lead routing and automation issues.

- Assist with Stripe and payment integrations.

- Configure
 authentication and sending domains.

- Work with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC when required.

- Diagnose account configuration problems.

- Test integrations end-to-end.

- Document issues and their resolutions.



Familiarity with Zapier, Make, Lovable, Google Workspace, and similar platforms is a strong advantage.



### Ongoing Client Support



- Respond to assigned technical support requests.

- Troubleshoot customer account issues.

- Make requested updates to funnels and workflows.

- Maintain accurate records of work completed.

- Monitor automation functionality.

- Identify opportunities to improve account configuration.

- Help standardize and improve our onboarding process.

- Create internal SOPs and reusable templates.



## Required Qualifications



**You must have significant hands-on experience with Votel.ai or GoHighLevel.**



We strongly prefer direct Votel experience, but will consider candidates with excellent GoHighLevel technical experience who can quickly adapt to Votel.



Requirements:



- At least 2 years of relevant CRM, funnel, and automation experience.

- Advanced knowledge of GoHighLevel or Votel.

- Proven ability to build complex workflows independently.

- Experience setting up and onboarding client accounts.

- Strong funnel and landing-page development skills.

- Experience with calendars, forms, pipelines, tags, and custom fields.

- Familiarity with webhooks and integrations.

- Ability to troubleshoot technical problems independently.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Excellent written English and clear communication.

- Ability to manage multiple client accounts and priorities.

- Reliable internet and a professional remote workspace.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



## Strongly Preferred Experience



- Direct Votel.ai experience

- GoHighLevel agency-level administration

- AI voice-agent setup and configuration

- White-label SaaS operations

- CRM migrations

- Snapshot/template development

- Stripe integrations

- Zapier or Make

- Webhook and API integrations

- DNS and
 authentication

- Contractor or home service industry experience

- Lovable website integrations

- Technical documentation and SOP development



## What Success Looks Like



We expect the person hired for this position to become productive quickly.



**First 3 Business Days**



- Become familiar with our existing account structure and service offerings.

- Review our onboarding process and technical standards.

- Demonstrate the ability to navigate Votel and complete assigned configuration tasks.

- Begin handling actual implementation work.



**First 2 Weeks**



- Independently configure new customer accounts.

- Build and troubleshoot workflows.

- Connect forms, funnels, calendars, and CRM pipelines.

- Complete assigned onboarding tasks with minimal supervision.

- Document configurations and testing results.



**Ongoing Expectations**



- Complete client onboarding accurately and efficiently.

- Maintain reliable automation systems.

- Meet agreed implementation deadlines.

- Resolve technical issues promptly.

- Reduce the amount of technical work requiring management involvement.

- Continuously improve our templates, workflows, and SOPs.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of technical implementation—not simply follow instructions.



## Compensation & Growth



We offer:



- Competitive monthly compensation based on demonstrated experience.

- Full-time, long-term opportunity.

- Consistent work with a growing US-based company.

- Direct collaboration with company leadership.

- Opportunity to develop and manage our technical operations.

- Access to relevant software and tools.

- Potential advancement into a Technical Operations Manager or Implementation Manager position.



Compensation will reflect your experience, technical capabilities, and ability to work independently.



## How to Apply



**Please read carefully. We will not consider generic applications.**



To apply, provide the following:



**1. Platform Experience**



How long have you worked with Votel.ai and/or GoHighLevel?



Clearly identify which platform you have actually used and your level of experience.



**2. Examples of Your Work**



Provide screenshots, videos, or examples of funnels, workflows, automations, or CRM systems you've personally built.



Please remove or conceal any confidential client information.



**3. Technical Experience**



Describe the most complex automation or integration you've personally built.



Explain the triggers, actions, conditional logic, and systems involved.



**4. Client Onboarding**



Walk us through how you would onboard a new home service contractor into Votel, from account creation to final testing.



**5. Troubleshooting**



A customer reports that leads are entering the CRM but are not receiving automated follow-up messages.



How would you diagnose and resolve the problem?



**6. Availability & Compensation**



Confirm your availability, expected monthly salary, and earliest possible start date.



**7. Video Introduction**



Provide a short 60–90-second video introducing yourself and explaining your technical experience with Votel or GoHighLevel.



### Important Application Instruction



Start your application with the exact words:



**VOTEL TECH SPECIALIST**



Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be considered.



## Final Note



We are not looking for someone who has simply watched GoHighLevel tutorials or completed a basic online course.



We want a proven technical specialist who has built real funnels, configured real automations, onboarded real customers, and solved real implementation problems.



If you're highly skilled in Votel or GoHighLevel, enjoy building systems, and want a long-term opportunity with a growing AI automation company, we'd like to hear from you.



**We are ready to hire the right person.**

We are looking for a data-driven, detail-oriented, and proactive Business Planning & Analysis Executive to support our multi-channel distribution business for beauty and health products. In this role, you will play a central role in managing online store operations, analyzing sales performance across health and beauty SKUs, optimizing inventory turnover, and monitoring channel profitability.



Key Responsibilities

E-commerce & Operations Support

- Assist in the day-to-day execution of e-commerce store operations across relevant platforms (e.g., Shopee, Lazada, Shopify, Amazon, Tik Tok Shop).

- Manage product listings, ensuring accurate product information, descriptions, images, tags, and category placements.

- Implement and update pricing strategies, campaign discounts, voucher setups, and promotional listings in coordination with marketing and management.



Sales, Profitability & Data Analysis

- Evaluate product-level profitability, discount impacts, and cost of goods sold (COGS) to identify growth drivers and areas for cost optimization.

- Prepare clear performance dashboards, reports, and forecasts to support decision-making for leadership.

- Track promotional performance and ROI for marketing campaigns and platform sales events (e.g., double-digit mega sales).



Inventory Management & Planning
