- Conduct stock turnover analysis and identify slow-moving, aging, or out-of-stock items.

- Collaborate with supply chain/procurement teams on demand forecasting, reorder triggers, and stock allocation. 



Qualifications & Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Statistics, Supply Chain Management, E-commerce, or a related field.

- 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, e-commerce operations, merchandising, or inventory planning.

- Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets (advanced formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data visualization).

- Familiarity with major e-commerce platforms and seller portals.

- Strong numerical aptitude with the ability to interpret complex data sets and draw practical insights.

- Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to present data findings clearly to stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have / A Plus)

- Experience or basic capability in maintaining automated scripts, basic programs, macro/VBA, or data pipelines.

- Familiarity with inventory management software (e.g, Bigseller) or BI tools (e.g, Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio).

title: Strategic Marketing Manager
description:
Schedule: 10 - 15 hours per week 

Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time mornings; Flexible

Start Date: 1 December 2026



Summary



We are seeking an experienced, creative, and results-driven Strategic Marketing Manager to help our client strengthen their online presence, develop an effective content strategy, and generate qualified leads through digital marketing.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on content creator who can take ownership of marketing initiatives from ideation to execution. This role goes beyond simply posting on social media. You will be expected to research industry trends, analyze competitors, identify opportunities, and proactively recommend marketing strategies that support business growth.



Our client operates in the financial and investment industry, so an interest in finance, investing, and business-related topics is highly desirable.



We are looking for a self-starter who can work independently, develop engaging content with minimal direction, and guide the client toward marketing decisions based on research and performance data.



Required Conditions



REQUIRED: Proven experience in digital marketing, social media management, and content strategy.

REQUIRED: Ability to develop and execute marketing strategies independently, rather than simply following instructions.

REQUIRED: Strong content creation skills, including writing, editing, repurposing, and publishing content across multiple platforms.

REQUIRED: Experience with basic video editing, short-form video production, and social media content optimization.

REQUIRED: Strong research and analytical skills, including competitor analysis, trend identification, and marketing performance evaluation.

REQUIRED: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

REQUIRED: Ability to work independently, take initiative, and generate content ideas even when the client has limited time to provide materials.

REQUIRED: Understanding of how content marketing contributes to audience growth, lead generation, and customer conversion.



Primary Responsibilities



1. Marketing Strategy & Planning



- Develop and implement a comprehensive content and digital marketing strategy aligned with the client's business objectives.

- Research the client's industry, competitors, target audience, and current marketing trends to identify opportunities.

- Evaluate existing marketing activities and recommend improvements based on performance and business goals.

- Identify the most effective marketing channels rather than simply posting across every platform.

- Build and manage a content calendar with clear objectives, priorities, and deadlines.

- Proactively advise the client on marketing direction, content opportunities, and strategic decisions.



2. Content Creation & Repurposing



- Develop original content ideas based on industry research, trending topics, audience interests, and the client's business expertise.

- Write and edit social media posts, LinkedIn articles, educational content, newsletters, and other marketing materials.

- Transform existing content into multiple formats, including text posts, articles, carousels, infographics, short-form videos, and interactive content.

- Repurpose long-form videos into engaging short-form clips optimized for individual social media platforms.

- Perform basic video editing, including trimming, resizing, captioning, and adding simple graphics.

- Use AI-powered tools to streamline content research, drafting, editing, and production while maintaining accuracy and quality.

- Independently research and develop content when the client is unable to provide raw materials or detailed instructions.



3. Social Media Management & Audience Growth



- Manage and optimize social media platforms, including LinkedIn,
, Instagram, TikTok, X 
), and YouTube.

- Adapt messaging, content formats, and publishing schedules to suit each platform's audience.

- Schedule and publish content consistently using social media management tools.

- Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness, engagement, reach, and follower growth.

- Monitor industry conversations, competitor activity, and emerging content trends.

- Recommend practical ways to position the client's business as a credible and recognizable voice within its industry.



4. Marketing Analytics, Lead Generation & Conversion



- Track and analyze content performance, website traffic, engagement, and lead-generation metrics.

- Understand how marketing content drives potential customers through the sales funnel, from awareness to conversion.

- Identify which content types, channels, and campaigns are generating meaningful business results.

- Recommend improvements based on performance data, not simply vanity metrics such as views and likes.

- Conduct content experiments and refine strategies based on measurable outcomes.

- Prepare regular performance reports highlighting key metrics, insights, and recommended next steps.

- Explore opportunities to convert social media audiences into website visitors, inquiries, and qualified leads.



5. Client Collaboration & Strategic Guidance



- Work directly with the client to understand their business, industry, services, target market, and competitive advantages.

- Conduct regular discussions to gather insights and align marketing activities with business priorities.

- Translate complex business or financial topics into clear, engaging, audience-friendly content.

- Take initiative in identifying content opportunities without depending on constant client direction.

- Respectfully challenge marketing assumptions when research or performance data suggests a better approach.

- Propose actionable solutions when client availability, content resources, or other constraints arise.



Preferred Experience & Skills



- Previous experience as a Marketing Manager, Digital Marketing Strategist, Content Strategist, or Social Media Manager.

- Experience marketing financial services, investment firms, wealth management, or other professional service businesses.

- Genuine interest in financial markets, investing, economics, and business news.

- Proficiency with content creation and design tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Descript, or VEED.

- Familiarity with scheduling platforms such as Buffer, SocialPilot, Social Champ, Hootsuite, or similar tools.

- Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for content ideation, research, and workflow improvement.

- Knowledge of SEO, website content optimization,
 marketing, and digital lead generation.

- Familiarity with Google Analytics, social media analytics, and marketing performance reporting.

- Strong copywriting skills, particularly for educational, thought-leadership, and conversion-focused content.

- Ability to work with limited supervision while managing multiple priorities.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly when creating content involving financial or investment topics.



Keywords



Strategic Marketing Manager, Digital Marketing Manager, Content Marketing Manager, Social Media Manager, Content Strategy, Digital Marketing, LinkedIn Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Content Creation, Content Repurposing, Video Editing, Lead Generation, Marketing Analytics, Competitor Research, Brand Awareness, Financial Services Marketing, SEO, AI Content Creation, Marketing Automation.

title: E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – Marketplace Operations
description:
E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – Marketplace Operations

Position Type: Full-Time (40 Hours per Week)



Work Setup: 100% Remote

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST)

Industry: E-Commerce / Online Retail



About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized, and reliable E-Commerce Virtual Assistant to manage day-to-day operations for a growing online retail business specializing in electronics and candy products.

In this backend-focused role, you will be responsible for streamlining daily operations across multiple sales channels (Amazon, eBay, Walmart, and Temu). Key duties include processing orders, coordinating shipping, synchronizing inventory, updating product listings, and handling customer inquiries.

If you are a proactive problem-solver with strong operational experience in multi-channel e-commerce management, we’d love to have you on our team!



Key Responsibilities

1. Order Processing & Fulfillment

Process and monitor daily incoming orders across Amazon, eBay, Walmart, and Temu.

Coordinate shipping and fulfillment activities to ensure all orders are dispatched on time.

Track shipment statuses, delivery updates, and proactively address fulfillment exceptions or delays.

Identify and resolve order discrepancies quickly and accurately.

Maintain complete and accurate transaction and order records.



2. Inventory Management

Monitor stock levels across all active online marketplaces.

Update stock quantities and product details directly through SellerCloud.

Prevent overselling, stockouts, and channel inventory discrepancies through regular audits.

Investigate and resolve inventory inconsistencies between sales channels.



3. Product Listing Management

Create, update, and manage product listings across Amazon, eBay, Walmart, and Temu.

Verify that listing titles, descriptions, pricing, backend search terms, and images are accurate and consistent.

Monitor listing health, identifying and fixing suppressed or error-flagged listings.

Assist with catalog organization and general listing administrative tasks.



4. Customer Service & Returns Management

Respond to customer inquiries via marketplace messaging tools in a timely, polite, and professional manner.

Resolve questions regarding order statuses, shipping, tracking details, and product specifics.

Process and coordinate returns, refunds, and replacements in strict accordance with company guidelines.

Escalate complex customer concerns or high-level issues when necessary.



5. Administrative & Operational Support

Assist with inbox management, operational spreadsheets, and reporting.

Help document recurring workflows and assist in creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Proactively communicate operational bottlenecks and offer practical solutions.



Qualifications & Requirements

MUST-HAVES / NON-NEGOTIABLE:

SellerCloud Experience: Direct, hands-on experience using SellerCloud is STRICTLY MANDATORY and NON-NEGOTIABLE.

Job Requirements: Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Job Overview

The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Recruitment Process:

I. Initial Interview

II. Activity Video (Applicant must complete the activity video)

III. Final Interview



NOTE: Previous applicant need NOT TO APPLY.

title: Founder's Representative | B2B Business Development, Partnerships & Executive Visibility
description:
Remote | Part-Time to Start | U.S. Central Business Hours | Long-Term Opportunity



I'm looking for a confident, personable, and resourceful professional who can represent me and my businesses, develop valuable relationships, and help turn those relationships into paying clients and professional opportunities.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant, data-entry position, or mass cold
 role. I already have someone managing cold outreach.



I need someone who can become a trusted professional representative—someone who learns my background, understands the value I bring, and can confidently communicate that value to others.



Who you'll be representing



I'm a Florida licensed construction contractor, business owner, and former enterprise banking systems professional.



My experience includes construction operations, financial and back-office management, enterprise systems, automation, and developing technology that solves real operational problems.



My company, Beau Monde Properties, provides back-office build management and operational support to residential builders.



I've spent years building the businesses, teams, and systems. Now I'm looking for someone who can help develop the relationships and opportunities that support their continued growth.



Your primary responsibility: Bring in business



Develop relationships with residential builders, contractors, developers, investors, and construction-focused accounting professionals.



Identify qualified prospects and potential referral partners.



Represent Beau Monde Properties in preliminary conversations with potential clients.



Explain our services clearly and confidently, without sounding scripted or overly sales-focused.



Discover potential clients' problems and help them understand how our services might benefit them.



Schedule qualified meetings and maintain consistent follow-up.



Track opportunities and help move interested prospects toward becoming paying clients.



Secondary responsibility: Build my professional visibility



Learn my professional background and accomplishments well enough to represent me accurately.



Identify podcast guest opportunities in construction, entrepreneurship, business systems, and technology.



Approach podcast hosts, professional organizations, and event coordinators about interviews and speaking engagements.



Develop meaningful introductions to people and organizations who could become clients, partners, or professional contacts.



Help communicate my professional experience through thoughtful outreach and relationship building.



The goal is not to become a social media influencer. The goal is to develop a credible professional reputation that creates genuine business opportunities.



The person I'm looking for



You should be:



An exceptional spoken and written English communicator.



Confident speaking with American business owners and executives.



Experienced in B2B business development, account management, relationship building, or executive representation.



Comfortable using the telephone,
, LinkedIn, and professional networking.



Naturally curious, personable, persuasive, and professional.



Capable of working independently and following through without constant direction.



Good at identifying opportunities rather than simply completing assigned tasks.



Able to promote someone else's expertise without exaggerating or sounding like a salesperson reading a script.



Experience in construction, professional services, public relations, or podcast outreach is a plus, but not required.



Working arrangement



This is a remote opportunity open to qualified applicants worldwide.



You must be available for agreed working periods during 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time, Monday through Friday, so we can work together and you can communicate with potential U.S. clients during their business day.



We'll begin with approximately 8–10 hours per week and a paid two-week trial, with the opportunity to expand based on performance, business needs, and mutual fit.



This is intended to become a long-term professional relationship.



What success looks like



During the first 30 days, I want you to:



Become knowledgeable about my background, services, and target customers.



Develop a qualified list of potential clients and referral partners.



Begin meaningful conversations with prospective clients.



Identify and pursue relevant podcast or speaking opportunities.



Schedule qualified introductions and business meetings.



Maintain a clear record of conversations, next steps, and potential opportunities.



We will measure success by the quality of relationships, qualified conversations, opportunities created, and ultimately new business—not simply the number of messages sent.



How to apply 

First, place "Business Development" and your name in the header.



Please answer these five questions:



Have you previously represented a founder, entrepreneur, executive, or professional-services business? Tell me what you did and the results you produced.



Give an example of a business relationship you personally developed that resulted in a client, partnership, or meaningful opportunity.



Imagine you're introducing me to a residential builder who already has a superintendent and a bookkeeper. How would you begin that conversation and explain why they might want to meet me?



Have you ever secured podcast interviews, speaking opportunities, or professional introductions? Please provide examples.



What is your hourly rate, where are you located, and what hours are you available in U.S. Central Time?



Finalists will be invited to a paid, live role-play conversation.



I'm looking for someone with good judgment, initiative, and genuine enthusiasm for connecting people and creating opportunities.



If you're someone who enjoys helping accomplished professionals become better known—and knows how to turn that visibility into real business relationships—I'd love to hear from you.

ROLE

We are looking for a skilled and driven Amazon PPC Manager with proven experience in the e-commerce industry, specifically working with the private label model. The PPC Manager is responsible for overseeing the brand's Amazon PPC performance. You will co-create PPC strategies with the brand owner by understanding overall business goals and aligning advertising efforts accordingly.



From launch to scale phases, you will be expected to build, optimize, and manage advertising campaigns, support new product launches, and consistently contribute insights to the broader brand management and product development teams.



RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategy:

• Document and publish the PPC strategy for internal use.

• Define PPC goals that align with both company-wide objectives and individual product targets.

• Convert brand goals into actionable PPC strategies.

• Identify external factors needed for PPC success (e.g., improved product images, review velocity).

• Update strategies regularly—yearly, quarterly, monthly, weekly—to meet evolving goals.

• Implement processes, workflows, and tools needed to execute strategies.

• Attend leadership meetings to realign on priorities and report on PPC performance.

• Develop an organized and effective campaign structure.

• Validate keyword research generated by the Product Development team.

• Test placements and monitor performance.

• Oversee Sponsored Products, Brands, Display campaigns, and explore new ad types like Video Ads.

• Feed PPC performance data back into the company to support decision-making.

• Maintain and update internal PPC SOPs.

• Execute PPC campaigns for new product launches.



3. Launch:

• Collaborate with Product Development to prepare for launches.

• Work with the SKU Optimization team to re-launch and fine-tune product positioning.



RESULTS EXPECTED

• PPC targets are aligned with company goals.

• Accurate measurement of PPC metrics.

• Ongoing optimization of campaign variables (bids, budgets, TOS bid adjusters).

• Launches rank new products within budget.

• Keyword graduation and negative matching are handled efficiently.

• Campaign structure and naming conventions are consistently followed.

• Ad spend is strategically allocated, minimizing waste.



REQUIREMENTS

• Proven experience in the e-commerce industry, ideally in a private label Amazon business model.

• Must have experience working in different Amazon marketplaces like US/CA/MX/UK/EU/AU/NZ/Middle East/South East Asia (any of these).

• Deep understanding of Amazon’s advertising ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience managing sponsored products, brands, and display ads.

• Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business goals into PPC action plans.

• Familiarity with launch strategies and performance tracking tools.

• Experience creating and maintaining SOPs.

• Detail-oriented and highly organized.

title: AI Video Producer & Editor (Higgsfield) - Meta Ads
description:
AI Video Producer & Editor (Higgsfield), Meta Ads



Company: SimplyGood (www.simplygood.sg)

Location: Remote, Philippines 

Type: Freelance / Contractor (Full Time)



About SimplyGood

SimplyGood makes waterless, plastic-free home care for families in Singapore and Malaysia: laundry detergent sheets, softener sheets, cleaning tablets and more. Our products work as well as the big brands, without the plastic jugs or harsh chemicals. Meta ads are our main growth engine, and we are moving most of our ad production to AI.



About the role

We already have the creative strategy. We have a bank of tested angles and more scripts than we can produce. What we are missing is someone who can take a script and turn it into a scroll-stopping, launch-ready Meta ad in hours, not days, mostly with AI. You are focused on: 

1. AI production: you generate the raw footage with AI, mainly in Higgsfield

2. Video editing: you cut those raws together into a finished, launch-ready Meta ad



You get approved scripts and briefs from our team. You produce the raws with AI, edit the full ad, and deliver it ready to go live. When an ad wins, you make more versions of it fast.



This role is measured on three things: 

1. How many launch ready ads you ship each week

2. Ad content metrics (Hook Rate, CTR, Video Avg watch time,..)

3. Winning Ads % - How many of them are winning ads



What you will do



1. Generate the raws (AI production)

- Based on the creative brief, generate every shot in Higgsfield (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana and whichever model is best that month): AI scenes, characters, B-roll, product shots and before-and-after moments

- Write and refine prompts for camera movement, lighting and action until each clip looks real

- Keep characters consistent across scenes and make sure our packaging matches our real products exactly

- Generate extra hook shots and alternate openings up front, so variations are quick later

- Create AI voiceovers in natural Singapore and Malaysia English (ElevenLabs or similar)



2. Edit it all together (video editing)

- Assemble the raws into a finished ad in CapCut or Premiere Pro

- Edit to direct-response standards: a hook in the first 2 seconds, tight pacing, no dead frames, a clear demo and a clear call to action

- Add captions, text overlays, product callouts, music, sound effects and transitions

- Mix AI raws with real creator, UGC, in-house and product footage when the brief needs it

- Clean up AI artefacts: warped hands, flicker, broken text, wrong labels. If it looks fake, it doesn't ship.

- Export in every placement we need (9:16, 4:5, 1:1), with safe zones respected for Reels and Stories





What we are looking / Must have

- AI Savvy - Familiar with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Higgsfield, Elevenlabs, ...

- At least 6 months of hands-on, weekly AI video production. Higgsfield is our main platform. If you are strong in Kling, Veo or Seedance elsewhere and can prove it, apply anyway.

- A portfolio of AI video ads you made for real brands (not just showreels or art clips), where you did both the generation and the edit

- At least 3 years of video editing for social media or paid ads, with strong skills in CapCut or Premiere Pro (cutting, captions, sound, colour, exports)

- You can take a folder of raw clips and turn it into a tight 15 to 45 second ad without someone holding your hand

- You understand why a paid social ad is different from a pretty video: hooks, retention, demos, proof, CTA

- Speed: once ramped up, you can ship 20 or more finished ads a week, a mix of new concepts and variations

- Reliability: you deliver on time without being chased, and you say early when something is blocked

- Good written English

title: Fact Checker (Script & Video)
description:
We make documentary-style videos that explain complex stories in a clear and engaging way for our YouTube channels:









Accuracy is central to what we do. As we scale, we're bringing on a dedicated Fact Checker to make sure everything we publish holds up to scrutiny — both what's said and what's shown.



Role Overview



You'll be responsible for verifying the accuracy of our content at two levels:



- Script fact-checking — verifying every factual claim in our scripts against reliable, credible sources before production begins.

- Video / visual fact-checking — reviewing the final cut to confirm that footage, images, maps, graphics, dates, and on-screen text actually match the script and are historically and visually accurate.



You're the last line of defence between a script and a published video, so precision and consistency matter more than speed.



What you'll actually do



- Check every factual claim in a script (names, dates, figures, events, technical/weapon/equipment details) against trustworthy primary and secondary sources.

- Flag anything unsupported, outdated, exaggerated, or incorrect, and suggest a corrected, sourced version.

- Verify visual accuracy in the edited video — that b-roll, stock footage, photos, maps, and graphics show the correct people, equipment, location, and era, with no anachronisms or mismatches to the narration.

- Provide clear, timestamped notes and source links so writers and editors can act on them without guesswork.

- Maintain a simple record of sources and verification decisions for each video.

- Communicate proactively — flag risks or unclear claims early, not after a video is scheduled.



Who we're looking for



- Meticulous and detail-obsessed. You notice the small inconsistency everyone else missed.

- A strong researcher. You know how to find reliable sources quickly and judge whether a source can be trusted.

- Comfortable verifying visuals — reverse image search, cross-referencing footage, spotting when an image or clip doesn't match the claim (OSINT-style verification is a big plus).

- Excellent written English comprehension — you can read a script closely and catch subtle inaccuracies in phrasing.

- Reliable and deadline-driven. We publish on a schedule, and verification is a fixed step in that pipeline.



Bonus points



- Genuine interest in or knowledge of military history, defense, geopolitics, or general knowledge/history topics.

- Background in journalism, research, academia, or professional fact-checking.

- Experience working with YouTube, documentary, or long-form video teams.

- Familiarity with Google Drive, Slack, and collaborative review workflows.



How to apply



Send us:

1. Your CV 

2. Answer why you are interested in position

3. A short note on your fact-checking or research experience (how this role fits your background)

4. A short answer: given a script claim like "this jet entered service in 1978," what steps would you take to confirm or correct it?



Contract & Hours



- Full-time freelance, 40 hours weekly, fully remote.

- Must follow company confidentiality, IP, and workflow policies.



Compensation



- $700 USD / month

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Property Operations and Bookkeeping Manager
description:
We are hiring an organized, proactive professional to manage property operations, bookkeeping, and administrative support across multiple rental portfolios. This role requires hands-on experience with both QuickBooks Online and DoorLoop.



You will coordinate daily operations, maintain accurate financial and property records, and follow tasks through to verified completion. You should be comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, and communicating clearly with tenants, guests, vendors, and management.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Property and lease administration: Maintain tenant and property records, prepare leases and renewals using approved templates, track signatures, and coordinate move-in and move-out requirements.

- Rental operations: Handle tenant and guest communications, monitor reservations and calendars, and coordinate cleaning, turnovers, supplies, and property readiness.

- Maintenance and utilities: Coordinate vendors, track repair requests through completion, monitor utility balances and due dates, and flag issues requiring attention or approval.

- QuickBooks Online bookkeeping: Process and categorize transactions, prepare invoices, track receivables and payables, reconcile accounts, and prepare monthly financial reports. Maintain supporting documentation and investigate discrepancies.

- DoorLoop administration: Keep property, tenant, lease, charge, payment, deposit, and maintenance records accurate and current.

- Task coordination and reporting: Maintain shared trackers, follow up on outstanding requests, coordinate assigned staff or vendors, and provide concise updates on progress, deadlines, and unresolved issues.

- Process improvement: Document procedures and identify practical ways to reduce errors, improve efficiency, and strengthen follow-through.

You must bring:

- Proven experience in property management or property operations, including long-term rentals and short-term rental coordination.

- Strong QuickBooks Online skills, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, bank and credit card reconciliations, and financial reporting.

- Practical DoorLoop experience, including maintaining tenant and lease records, reviewing charges and payments, and tracking maintenance.

- Strong spreadsheet, document organization, and written communication skills.

- The ability to manage multiple portfolios while keeping records separate and organized.

- Sound judgment, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

Success in this role means accurate records, timely reporting, proactive communication, and completed work that does not require repeated reminders. You must follow established procedures, protect confidential information, and obtain required approvals.



To apply, submit your résumé and briefly describe your experience with QuickBooks Online, DoorLoop, and rental property operations. Include an example of a bookkeeping discrepancy or operational issue you resolved independently.

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder (A-Players Only)
description:
Company: ARSA (Auto Repair Sales Accelerator) / NGD Media 



Reports to: Theo Singh, Founder - Remote (must work UK business hours) 

Pay: [$1200 - $2200+ based on experience] + performance bonus



READ THIS FIRST

This is not an easy job. It is not a “nice little admin role”, and it is not for everyone.

You will work directly with the founder of a fast-moving marketing agency that runs Meta and Google ads and CRM systems for 80+ businesses across the UK and US. Things move quickly, priorities change daily and you’ll be juggling a lot at once.



If you want a calm 9–5 with clear instructions for every task, please don’t apply. WE MEAN THAT.



You will be expected to be responsive 24/7.

If you’re the person who gets handed something you’ve never done before and says “leave it with me”, and then actually gets it done, keep reading.



What you’ll actually be doing

1. Owning Theo’s WhatsApp inbox - Manage a busy WhatsApp inbox: clients, team, partners, leads and suppliers - Reply on Theo’s behalf, in his voice, to anything you can handle yourself - Triage the rest: what needs Theo today, what can wait, what goes to someone else - Make sure nothing gets missed, forgotten or left on “read” - Give Theo a short daily summary or call: what’s done, what’s waiting on him, what’s on fire



2. Delegating and chasing the team - Turn Theo’s voice notes and quick messages into clear tasks for the right person (ops, client success, sales, creative) - Follow up until tasks are done. Chasing is part of the job, not an extra - Spot when something is stuck and fix it before Theo has to ask



3. Anything and everything else - Calendar and diary management, booking and rescheduling calls - Research: competitors, prospects, suppliers, tools, new markets - Preparing docs, briefs, slides, spreadsheets and reports - Keeping track of projects and side ventures so nothing slips - Using AI tools to get things done faster - Personal and business admin as it comes up - Whatever else lands on your desk. It will be varied, and some of it you’ll have never done before



Who we’re looking for:

Must-haves - Perfect written and spoken English. You’ll be speaking for Theo to clients and partners. Typos and clumsy wording are not OK - A genuine “can do” attitude. “I don’t know how” is never the end of the sentence. It’s “I don’t know how yet, I’ll figure it out” - Resourceful. You Google it, YouTube it, ask AI, test it and come back with it done, not with questions you could have answered yourself - Extremely organised. You can juggle 30 open loops and still know exactly where each one is

Fast and responsive. Quick replies are a must. This role runs on speed - Proactive. You don’t wait to be told. You see what needs doing and do it - Discreet. You’ll see sensitive client, financial and personal information - Owns mistakes. When something goes wrong you say so straight away, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again



Strongly preferred - Experience working in or with a marketing agency (paid ads, CRM, client accounts) - Previous EA / PA / operations / project-management experience supporting a founder or exec - Comfortable with tools like Google Workspace, Slack, WhatsApp Business, GoHighLevel, ClickUp/Notion and ChatGPT or similar AI tools



What A-player looks like here:

Theo gives you a vague task at 10am. By the afternoon it’s done, and you’ve flagged two things he didn’t think of

Theo doesn’t have to remember anything, because you already have

The team know that when you ask for something, you’ll follow up

Clients get faster and better replies than they did before you arrived



After 90 days, Theo has hours back every week and wonders how he managed without you



Who this is NOT for

People who need step-by-step instructions for everything

People who say “that’s not my job”

People who get flustered when priorities change mid-day

People who need to be chased

People who say i haven’t done that before



What you get

Work directly with a founder and learn how a growing agency really runs, from sales and ads to operations and client success

A huge variety of work. You won’t be bored



Room to grow into an Operations / Chief of Staff role if you crush it



Fully remote

How to apply

We get a lot of applications, so here’s how we spot the people who read properly and follow instructions:



Submit a loom video explaining why you are the best fit FOR THIS SPECIFIC ROLE

Include your CV or LinkedIn



Applications that don’t follow these steps won’t be reviewed.

title: VA - Guest Communication & Operations @ Restay Homes
description:
Hi!



My name is Nikita, I'm the founder of Restay Vacation Homes Rental - a short-term rental management company based in Dubai.



We manage 35+ furnished apartments in Dubai under sublease and property management, from studios to 3-bedrooms. We've held Airbnb Superhost status for the past year with a 4.8-4.9 rating across the whole portfolio, and we're adding units every month.



We're looking for one more VA to join our operations team.



WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY IS



Communication is most of it. You'll be in our CRM, in Slack and on WhatsApp all day - talking to guests, cleaners, maintenance, contractors, suppliers and owners, and keeping our internal team informed. The rest is paperwork: passport and registration documents, DTCM, records, reports. Getting it right, and getting it finished.



Guest relations:



- Manage guest communication, inbound and outbound

- Coordinate check-in and check-out

- Handle issues during a stay and follow them through to a result, not just a reply

- Coordinate cleaners and suppliers via WhatsApp and Slack



Maintenance coordination:



- Log every reported issue and keep it visible until it's actually fixed

- Dispatch technicians, including after hours, and confirm the job was done

- Chase contractors and suppliers who go quiet

- Spot problems that keep coming back and say so



New unit launches:



- Coordinate a new apartment from handover to first booking - furniture delivery, installation, deep clean, photos, keys and access

- Handle the paperwork: DTCM registration, documents, listing setup across platforms

- Keep the owner and the internal team updated on where each unit stands



Operations and admin:



- Collect and process guest documents for registration - on time, every time

- Keep our CRM accurate: bookings, unit status, guest records

- Prepare and check reports and documents

- Escalate the right things to the senior team, and only the right things



Systems, as you grow into it:



- Write and maintain SOPs

- Improve how the team works, not just do the tasks

- Build simple automations between our tools



TWO THINGS MATTER MORE TO US THAN ANYTHING ELSE



You chase things until they're done.



Most of this job is waiting on other people - a guest who hasn't sent a document, a contractor who read your message and didn't answer, an owner sitting on an approval. Asking once is not doing the task. We need someone who tracks every open thread, notices who has gone quiet, and pushes again - politely, on a schedule, switching channel and escalating when it isn't working. Silence from the other side is not a finished task.



You check before you answer.



When a source contradicts what we've written, or something doesn't add up, stop and find out which is true rather than passing on the first answer you found. Being right matters more here than being fast, and one good question beats a confident wrong answer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You follow up. You have a real system for tracking what you're waiting on

- You verify. You notice when two sources disagree and you resolve it

- Fluent English, written and spoken - natural and clear, not translated-sounding

- You own tasks. You d
 what you can d
 and escalate what you can't

- Structured. You follow SOPs, and you write them when they're missing

- Accurate with detail - numbers, dates, documents

- Comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets, Slack, WhatsApp



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- 6+ months in Airbnb operations or another short-term rental company

- 6+ months in a small team or startup

- Experience helping a company scale from 10 to 50+ units is a big plus

- Familiarity with guest communication, pricing tools, turnover coordination

title: E-Commerce Video Editor (AI B-ROLL AND CHARACTERS)
description:
QUICK SUMMARY



Daily Output: 3–4 concepts per day including revisions

Video Length: Typically 60–200 seconds

Focus: High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

Location: Remote

Pay: $10 per completed minute of video for the first month → $15 per completed minute from the second month onwards

Bonus Scheme: Up to $1,000 for winning ads based on performance



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content.



While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback.



Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily Concept Production

Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



AI-Assisted Product Cinematography

Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement and seamless integration into real-world edits.



Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



AI Character & Voice Integration

Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers and emotional delivery when required.



End-to-End Post Production

Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, colour grading, pacing, revisions and final export delivery.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL STACK



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



AI Video Generation



Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

Kling

Luma Dream Machine



Voice / Character Tools



HeyGen

ElevenLabs

D-ID



Image Generation



Midjourney v6+

Leonardo.ai



Editing & Post Production



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop



AI Enhancement



Topaz Video AI

REQUIREMENTS



Speed & Efficiency

You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



Understanding of Advertising

You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling and what makes ads convert.



Attention to Detail

You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion or low-quality visual details.



Strong English & Audio Awareness

Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers or direct voice delivery properly.



Work Ethic & Communication

Communication, reliability, speed and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



PAY



Compensation is based on completed video output.



First Month

$10 per completed minute of video



Second Month Onwards

$15 per completed minute of video



The more completed video work you produce, the more you can earn.



BONUS SCHEME FOR WINNING ADS



On top of the normal per-minute pay, there are additional bonuses for ads you create that become winning ads.



$200 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending over $200 per day at a 1.8 ROAS or above = $200 bonus



$1,000 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending $1,000 per day at a 2.0 ROAS or above = $1,000 bonus



These bonuses are paid on top of your normal per-minute video compensation.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work and product ad creatives

Examples of product b-roll and/or talking character content

A list of the AI tools you currently use or pay for regularly

NEURAL

•Convert attention into measurable action: membership inquiries and subscriptions, event registrations, community participation, sponsor leads and partner opportunities.



•Create a sponsor-ready media product with consistent programming, audience intelligence and professional reporting.



•Build a reusable content library that strengthens ICABA-TV, Black Professionals Month and other priority programs.



Recording and Production



•Produce and direct remote, studio, hybrid and live-event recordings; manage platform setup, audio routing, lighting/framing guidance and recording redundancy.



•Open each episode with a strong audience hook and structure conversations for pace, clarity, emotional resonance and retention.



•Edit audio and video to professional standards, including cleanup, color correction, leveling, music, branded graphics, captions, lower thirds and sponsor elements.



•Deliver platform-appropriate masters, thumbnails and metadata; perform final quality control before release.



•Create and maintain production templates, brand standards, file naming, archives and backup procedures.





Content Marketing and Repurposing



•Turn each full episode into a coordinated content package designed for discovery, engagement and conversion.



•Identify the strongest insights, stories and quotable moments; edit vertical and horizontal clips with captions and compelling opening text.



•Create or direct supporting assets such as audiograms, quote cards, carousels, blog/article summaries and newsletter features.



•Build an evergreen redistribution plan so high-performing episodes continue generating traffic after launch week.



Audience Growth and Conversion



•Create a clear conversion path for every episode: one primary CTA, trackable link or QR code, relevant landing page, and follow-up nurture sequence.



•Coordinate with ICABA’s web, CRM and email resources to capture source data and reduce friction from content to registration or purchase

title: SENIOR Art Director
description:
Luxury Fashion | Global Brand | Australia-Based



The Opportunity



We’re seeking an exceptional SENIOR Art Director to join a fast-paced, creatively ambitious team at an Australian-based luxury fashion brand with a global presence.



This is an opportunity for a highly experienced, agency-trained creative with a strong visual point of view, a refined understanding of luxury, and a portfolio spanning top-tier clients, campaigns and creative projects.



You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping and elevating the brand’s visual identity across global touch points, bringing together fashion, culture, art direction and commercial creativity to deliver work that is distinctive, considered and world-class.



Working in a high-performance environment, you’ll collaborate with a passionate team to translate brand vision into compelling creative, balancing conceptual thinking with exceptional execution.



The role is Australian-based, working local hours within the Australian time zone, collaborating with a global brand and its international audience.



About the Role



As Senior Art Director, you’ll lead the development and execution of creative concepts across a rebrand, then roll out campaigns, brand storytelling, web and digital, social, editorial and full scope brand experiences.



You’ll bring the creative rigour and pace of a leading agency environment, combined with an instinctive understanding of luxury aesthetics, fashion imagery and the details that distinguish premium creative from the ordinary.



From the initial concept through to final delivery, you’ll champion creative excellence, maintain consistency across brand touch points and push the boundaries of how the brand shows up in the world.



Key Responsibilities



- Creative Direction & Concept Development: Develop distinctive, culturally relevant creative concepts that elevate brand perception and reinforce a compelling global identity.

- Campaign Art Direction: Lead visual development across fashion campaigns, editorial shoots, brand content and integrated creative projects.

- Visual Storytelling: Bring a sophisticated understanding of imagery, typography, composition, colour and design to every creative output.

- Brand Consistency: Uphold and evolve the brand’s visual codes across digital, social, e-commerce, print and campaign environments.

- Shoot Direction: Collaborate with photographers, stylists, talent, producers and creative partners to deliver exceptional visual outcomes.

- Creative Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams and external agencies to translate strategic objectives into ambitious, high-quality creative.

- Executional Excellence: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining exceptional standards while working to demanding timelines.

- Creative Leadership:Bring clarity, confidence and creative rigour to the process, inspiring those around you and contributing to a culture of high standards.



About You



You are an agency-experienced Senior Art Director with a proven track record of delivering exceptional creative for recognised, top-tier clients. A cool mood board, unique eye and a history of artistic delivery. 



You combine conceptual strength with an elevated visual sensibility and understand how to build brands through powerful, cohesive and emotionally resonant creative.



You thrive in fast-moving environments where expectations are high, details matter and the work must consistently meet a world-class standard.



You are commercially aware without compromising creativity, confident presenting and defending your ideas, and comfortable navigating multiple stakeholders, projects and priorities.



What You Bring



- Significant experience as a Senior Art Director within a leading creative, advertising, fashion or branding agency.

- A standout portfolio of top-tier clients and high-calibre creative projects, demonstrating conceptual depth, visual sophistication and exceptional execution.

- A strong understanding of luxury fashion, premium brand positioning and contemporary visual culture.

- A distinctive creative point of view, with the ability to develop ideas that feel both original and strategically relevant.

- Proven experience art directing campaigns, shoots and multi-channel creative.

- A refined eye for detail and an instinctive understanding of what makes creative feel elevated, timeless and culturally resonant.

- The ability to move seamlessly between big-picture creative thinking and hands-on execution.

- Strong communication, presentation and collaboration skills.

- The ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outstanding work in a fast-paced environment.

- A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a genuine appetite to raise the creative bar.



The Ideal Candidate



You have been shaped by the pace, standards and creative ambition of a leading agency environment. You know what exceptional looks like because you’ve helped create it.



Your portfolio speaks for itself: considered concepts, beautifully executed campaigns, ambitious projects and work for clients with high expectations. Web design and digital experience.



You understand that luxury is not simply an aesthetic. It’s a feeling, a perspective and an uncompromising attention to every detail.



You bring energy, curiosity and conviction to the work, thrive under pressure and are motivated by the opportunity to build something distinctive with a team that shares your ambition.



 Why Join Us?



- The opportunity to shape the creative expression of an Australian-based luxury fashion brand with global reach.

- A fast-paced, ambitious environment where creativity, quality and attention to detail are paramount.

- The opportunity to work across a diverse range of high-impact brand and campaign initiatives.

- Collaboration with a driven team operating at the intersection of fashion, culture and creative innovation.

- An opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the evolution of a global luxury brand, while working Australian local hours.



Apply



Essential for Application - Degree qualified in related field, Agency Experience, Portfolio of Rebrand Projects, Fashion and luxury industry experience preferred.



If you’re an agency-trained Senior Art Director an exceptional portfolio, a strong creative point of view and a passion for elevating luxury brands, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your CV (pdf) and portfolio link, highlighting the clients, campaigns and creative projects that best demonstrate your experience and capabilities.



We’re looking for exceptional creative talent with the ambition, judgement and craft to deliver work at the highest level. A unique point of view and artistry.

description:

This is not a basic editing role where scripts, footage, and concepts are provided.





What You Will Do:

• Find strong hooks, angles, pain points, desires, and creative concepts



• Write direct-response scripts and d
 the complete video structure



• Source UGC, product demonstrations, competitor content, reviews, and other useful footage



• Generate missing footage, actors, voiceovers, images, or scenes using AI



• Edit high-converting ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest



• Create multiple hooks, angles, openings, and variations for each product



• Work with products from different niches and categories, such as home, beauty, wellness, gadgets, outdoor products, and other general e-commerce products

Requirements:

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist / Team Lead
description:
Full-Time · Remote · Worldwide · E-commerce



We’re looking for someone to take ownership of customer support at a fast-growing international e-commerce company.



At Anodys, we build and scale consumer products across dozens of international markets.



Our business is growing quickly, and we currently receive approximately 300 customer support tickets per day across our online stores.



We already have:



* An established customer support platform (Commslayer)

* AI agents handling approximately 60% of incoming tickets

* Existing SOPs and support processes

* Automated translation across international markets

* A technical team responsible for AI development and integrations

* An operations team overseeing the broader business



What we’re missing is an exceptional person to take ownership of day-to-day customer support.



Someone who handles customers brilliantly, moves fast, solves problems independently, improves processes, and eventually helps us build a small, highly effective support team.



This is not a role where you’ll spend your day waiting for instructions.



We want someone who sees a problem and fixes it.



What you’ll own



1. Customer Support



You’ll initially be very hands-on.



You’ll handle customer conversations involving:



* Order tracking and delivery questions

* Refunds and returns

* Cancellations and order changes

* Missing, damaged, or incorrect products

* Product questions

* Complaints and escalations

* Other customer issues across our stores



We expect fast, clear, professional communication and genuine problem-solving.



You’ll have SOPs to work from, but we want someone who can think independently rather than blindly follow scripts.



2. Support Operations



You’ll help ensure that our customer support operation runs smoothly.



This includes:



* Managing the daily ticket queue

* Prioritizing urgent cases

* Preventing ticket backlogs

* Monitoring response and resolution times

* Identifying recurring problems

* Improving existing SOPs

* Maintaining consistent support quality

* Escalating operational issues to the right people

* Reporting important trends to management



We don’t want someone who just closes tickets.



We want someone who notices why tickets keep appearing and helps eliminate the underlying problems.



3. AI Support Quality



Our AI agents already handle a large portion of customer conversations.



You won’t be responsible for building the AI systems from scratch. We have a technical team and Head of Operations handling that.



However, you’ll help improve the system by:



* Reviewing AI conversations

* Identifying incorrect or unhelpful responses

* Spotting situations where AI should escalate to a human

* Reporting missing information or broken workflows

* Suggesting improvements to our knowledge base and SOPs

* Working with our operations and technical teams to improve automation quality



The goal is to automate more support without sacrificing customer experience.



4. Customer Feedback & Reporting



We want someone who can turn customer conversations into useful business insights.



For example:



If customers repeatedly complain about a specific product, shipping issue, confusing offer, or checkout experience, we want you to identify the pattern and report it.



You’ll help us understand:



* Why customers contact support

* Which products generate the most complaints

* Why customers request refunds

* Where delivery problems occur

* Which support processes create unnecessary friction

* What could be improved across the business



You don’t need to be a data scientist.



But you should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, basic reporting, and support metrics.



5. Team Leadership



As the business grows, you may help:



* Recruit additional support agents

* Train new hires

* Review their work

* Maintain quality standards

* Organize shifts and coverage

* Manage support performance



We want someone who can grow into a Team Lead role if they prove themselves.



There may be opportunities for broader responsibility later, but we’re primarily hiring someone who can execute exceptionally well today.



Who we’re looking for



You should have:



* Strong experience in e-commerce customer support

* Excellent written English

* Experience handling significant ticket volumes

* Experience with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms

* Experience with customer support software

* Strong judgment when handling refunds, complaints, and difficult customers

* Excellent organization and attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Comfort using AI tools and automation

* Ability to identify operational improvements

* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset



Experience with Commslayer is a plus, but not required.



Experience managing or training other support agents is a major plus.



Experience with international e-commerce, logistics, fulfillment, refunds, and chargebacks is also valuable.



How we work



We’re a small, fast-moving, international team.



We value:



* Speed

* Ownership

* Clear communication

* Good judgment

* Independence

* Practical problem-solving

* Continuous improvement



We don’t have unnecessary meetings or complicated corporate processes.



We give capable people responsibility and expect them to deliver.



If you need constant supervision, this probably isn’t the right environment.



If you enjoy taking ownership and making things run better, you’ll likely enjoy working with us.



Working arrangement



* Full-time

* 100% remote

* Worldwide applicants welcome

* Excellent written English required

* Working hours and time-zone overlap to be agreed

* Some weekend coverage may be required through a planned team schedule

* Long-term opportunity

* Competitive fixed compensation based on experience and ability



We’re willing to pay well for someone exceptional.



What success looks like



Within your first month, we’d expect you to:



* Understand our stores, products, systems, and SOPs

* Take ownership of the human support queue

* Handle tickets efficiently and accurately

* Reduce unnecessary escalations

* Identify the most common customer complaints

* Establish clear support reporting

* Identify opportunities to improve AI responses

* Suggest practical improvements to our workflows

* Help us determine the right future staffing and coverage structure



Ultimately, we want customer support to become something that runs smoothly without constant management involvement.



How to apply



Please answer the following questions directly. Generic applications will not be considered.



1. Experience



Tell us about the largest e-commerce customer support operation you’ve personally worked in.



What type of business was it? How many tickets did you handle per day? What were your responsibilities?



2. Speed and workload



Imagine you start tomorrow and find 120 tickets requiring human attention.



How would you organize your day to handle them efficiently without sacrificing quality?



3. Difficult customer



Describe a real situation where you handled an angry customer or complicated refund request.



What happened, what did you do, and what was the outcome?



4. Problem-solving



Tell us about a recurring customer support problem you identified and helped solve.



We want an actual example, not a hypothetical one.



5. AI and automation



Our AI agents currently handle approximately 60% of tickets.



How would you evaluate whether the AI is doing a good job? What would you look for when reviewing conversations?



6. Reporting



What customer support metrics would you track weekly, and why?



7. Leadership



Have you ever trained, hired, or managed customer support agents?



If yes, tell us about your experience.



8. Practical scenario



A customer ordered a supplement three weeks ago. Tracking shows the package hasn’t moved for 12 days. The customer is angry and demands an immediate refund.



What exactly would you do?



9. First week



You join Monday.



We have multiple Shopify stores, approximately 300 tickets/day, existing SOPs, AI automation, and a technical team.



What would you aim to accomplish by Friday?



10. Availability and compensation



Please include:



* Your country and time zone

* Current employment situation

* Availability for full-time work

* Weekend availability

* Expected monthly compensation in USD

* Earliest possible start date



We’re looking for someone who wants to take real ownership, not just answer tickets.

title: Job title: Senior AI Automation Engineer (n8n, APIs, Claude/GPT, Shopify, Odoo) (Full-time)
description:
Type of work: Full-time, remote, long-term (occasional in-person work sprints)

Salary: USD 2,000–3,500 / month, depending on experience (+ performance bonus)

Hours: Flexible, with daily overlap with Manila time (UTC+8)



About us

We are an international group running e-commerce brands (DTC), a cosmetics factory, and sourcing and trading operations across Tunisia, the UAE, China and the Philippines. We are building an AI-powered operating system for the whole group and need a senior engineer to design, build and run it. This is not a learning role: you already live in automations and AI agents.



What you will build



Automation backbone: production-grade workflows in n8n (or Make) connecting our tools, with error handling, logging and monitoring.

Sales reconciliation: end-to-end tracking from Meta Ads to WooCommerce/Shopify to Odoo, to measure real ROAS on cash actually collected (COD).

Integrations: Meta Marketing API and Conversions API, Shopify and WooCommerce APIs, Odoo (XML-RPC/JSON-RPC), Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business.

AI agents: Claude and GPT-based agents for ad monitoring, landing page checks, product research, reporting and anomaly detection.

MCP connectors: let the founder query and pilot operations in natural language from Claude.

READ THIS FIRST

This is a full-time, exclusive position. You cannot have another job, another client or freelance work on the side. We check, and we end the contract if we find out.

Flow Pouch is a fast-growing US direct-to-consumer brand. We make functional mushroom pouches, a nicotine-free alternative to nicotine pouches, and we sell through paid video ads. Our editors make the ads that run the business. Expectations are very high and the KPIs are not negotiable.

Produce at least 7 fully edited videos a week, 1 to 5 minutes long, from written briefs. Generations are done in Higgsfield; editing is in the software of your choice (Premiere, DaVinci, CapCut, anything you are fast in). You work on a fixed weekly schedule inside our brief and feedback system with a strategist and the editing lead.

Extensive, provable experience generating AI video (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway or similar) and editing it into finished 2+ minute videos. You will send examples of exactly this. Short clips, reels or motion graphics showreels do not count.

Speed. A finished video in a day, not in two.

Fluent written English, a reliable connection and a machine that handles long-form editing.

Full-time availability on a schedule aligned to our team.



HOW WE HIRE

Shortlisted applicants get a test task that takes 2 hours or more and must be returned within 24 hours. It mirrors the real work: if you can do the job, you can do the test. It is unpaid and we do not use the output.



PAY AND TERMS

$1500 up to $2000 per month for top talents, full-time contractor, paid monthly. Part of the pay is tied to hitting the weekly KPI: editors who hit the number every week earn the full amount, editors who do not, do not.



WHO THIS IS FOR

Hungry, talented editors who want to go all in with one company, get very good at the newest AI tools and build a career with us as we grow. Not for anyone looking for a side income or a second job.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the wordHIGGSFIELD so we know you read this. Then send:



- Three links to AI-generated and edited videos of 2+ minutes that you made yourself, with one sentence each on what you generated and what you edited.

- The tools you used.

- Confirmation that you have no other job or clients, and your earliest start date.



Applications missing any of the three will not be answered.

-Independent contractor, not employment: written agreement and confidentiality agreement. You choose when and how you work, keep other clients, and invoice us.

US$140 per 14 days against the targets, plus a payment for every qualified meeting above target, with no cap. The dialer does the dialling; the meetings are where you earn more. You



Proven outbound cold calling into Australia, New Zealand or a similar market, clear spoken English, careful with logging and compliance, and a Philippine TIN with your own self-employed practice.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant, Recruitment & Operations (AI-savvy, full-time)
description:
Executive Virtual Assistant, Shopify & AI Operations (Full-time)



Type of work: Full-time, remote, long-term

Salary: USD 800–1,100 / month, depending on experience (+ performance bonus)

Hours: 8h/day, Manila time (UTC+8). Some flexibility needed for calls with Tunisia and Dubai.



About us

We are an international group running e-commerce brands (DTC) and a cosmetics factory, with sourcing and trading operations across Tunisia, the UAE, China and the Philippines. You will work directly with the founder as his right hand. Half your job is keeping his day organized; the other half is running Shopify and AI-powered operations.



Part 1: Shopify & AI operations



Shopify store management: add and update products (titles, descriptions, images, variants, prices), manage collections, discounts and basic apps.

Store checks: verify that product pages, links, checkout and ads' landing pages work (no broken links, no wrong product).

Orders: track orders and follow up on issues (COD confirmations, delays, returns) with the logistics team.

AI-powered work: use Claude and ChatGPT daily to write product descriptions, research competitors and products, summarize data and draft messages.

Automations: help set up and maintain simple automations (Zapier, Make or n8n) with our developer.

Market & competitor watch: monitor competitor stores and ads, and report new products or trends weekly.



Part 2: Executive support (daily)



Recruitment & sourcing: find candidates and agencies (LinkedIn, Upwork, OnlineJobs), contact them one by one, follow up and book calls.

Tracking: keep a clean tracker of candidates, partners and tasks (Google Sheets / ClickUp).

Scheduling: manage the founder's calendar across time zones (Manila, Shanghai, Dubai, Tunisia).

Meeting minutes: send a summary after every call (decisions, owners, deadlines), then follow up until each item is done.

Reports: turn research into clean 1–2 page reports (PDF / Google Docs).

Admin: inbox triage and document collection.



Must have



2+ years of hands-on Shopify experience (product uploads, collections, apps, orders)

2+ years supporting a founder or CEO as an assistant or VA

Daily user of AI tools (Claude or ChatGPT), with concrete examples

Excellent written and spoken English

Very organized, proactive, discreet, with strong follow-up discipline

Stable internet + backup power



Nice to have



Zapier / Make / n8n experience

Meta Ads basics (Ads Manager, pixel)

Experience with COD e-commerce or Middle East markets

French



How to apply (applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed)



Subject line: "EMPIRE-SHOPIFY-VA – [Your Name]"

Answer in 3–5 lines each:

Which Shopify stores have you worked on, and what exactly did you do?

Give one concrete example of how AI saved you time at work.

What is your availability and expected monthly rate?

Send a 2-minute Loom video in English, introducing yourself and showing a Shopify admin you have worked in (hide any confidential data).
